title: Bitcoin price-metric basket sees longest capitulation since FTX blow-up: Glassnode
summary: Glassnode confirmed that its aggregate BTC price cycle tool was in its coldest phase since the collapse of FTX in late 2022.
full_text:
Bitcoin price-metric basket sees longest capitulation since FTX blow-up: Glassnode
Glassnode confirmed that its aggregate BTC price cycle tool was in its coldest phase since the collapse of FTX in late 2022.
Bitcoin price-metric basket sees longest capitulation since FTX blow-up: Glassnode
Bitcoin (BTC) is seeing its longest capitulation since the end of the 2022 bear market, onchain analytics platform Glassnode reported on Monday.
Key points:
- 45 Bitcoin price metrics tracked by Glassnode are in their longest “capitulation” phase since the collapse of FTX in late 2022.
- Aggregate readings still have to turn colder to match areas that marked previous bear-market bottoms, says creator Rafael Schultze-Kraft.
45 Bitcoin price metrics spend 2026 in “capitulation” zone
Glassnode’s Bitcoin Cycle Position Heatmap, a composite BTC price metric overview tool, has signaled capitulation throughout 2026.
The tool, created by the platform’s co-founder, Rafael Schultze-Kraft, combines data from 45 indicators to present an overall picture of market health as Bitcoin price cycles repeat. A majority blue heatmap indicates a period of “capitulation” within the cycle, with red pointing to the euphoria characteristic of momentum toward cycle peaks.
After a euphoric phase in November 2021, the heatmap flipped to blue for the majority of 2022. In November that year, cryptocurrency exchange FTX collapsed, an event that coincided with Bitcoin’s last bear-market bottom of $15,600.
“Today it sits in its coldest stretch since FTX: late in the bear, but not yet the unanimous deep blue that previously marked a floor,” Schultze-Kraft commented on the Heatmap’s latest readings.
Bitcoin Cycle Position Heatmap. Source: Rafael Schultze-Kraft on X.com
In addition to basic price gauges such as market cap, the heatmap puts a considerable focus on the profitability of the Bitcoin investor base, dividing it into short-term (STH) and long-term (LTH) holders.
Certain metrics, Schultze-Kraft notes, change their behavior over time, requiring a more nuanced reading when used for cycle signals. Among these is dormancy — the number of days a unit of BTC has spent idle when used in an onchain transaction. Here, the ageing investor base means that dormancy increases over time, differing between cycles.
Coldcard hack spikes sub-1 BTC transactions
In its latest Market Pulse report released on Monday, Glassnode was complimentary regarding the resilience of market participants.
Related: US yen intervention puts Bitcoin, risk assets on notice for liquidity flux
“On-chain activity strengthened materially. Daily active addresses and entity-adjusted transfer volumes moved above their upper statistical bands, indicating a notable increase in network engagement and economic throughput,” it reported.
Stabilization of capital outflows remained despite a knee-jerk reaction by certain investors in the wake of the low-entropy bug exploit in Coldcard hardware wallets.
Data from analytics platform CryptoQuant likened the uptick in onchain transactions of 1 BTC or less to the aftermath of the FTX implosion. On July 31, the daily tally reached 39,600 BTC, compared with 39,900 on Nov. 16, 2022.

title: BlackRock brings tokenized money market funds to Europe via JPMorgan
summary: JPMorgan’s Kinexys platform will tokenize select BlackRock money market fund shares denominated in pounds, euros and US dollars.
full_text:
BlackRock brings tokenized money market funds to Europe via JPMorgan
JPMorgan’s Kinexys platform will tokenize select BlackRock money market fund shares denominated in pounds, euros and US dollars.
BlackRock will offer tokenized versions of select European money market funds using JPMorgan’s blockchain infrastructure.
According to a Tuesday Bloomberg report, the offering will include pound sterling, euro and US dollar share classes from BlackRock’s Institutional Cash Series, which collectively manage about $311 billion. The figure refers to the broader fund range, not the assets that will be tokenized.
Each token will represent a share in an underlying money market fund and can be transferred around the clock between approved digital wallets.
JPMorgan’s Kinexys will provide the tokenization infrastructure, while the bank will continue to serve as the transfer agent for the funds.
Beccy Milchem, BlackRock’s global head of cash distribution and head of international cash management, said the asset manager has seen interest from digital wallet providers, corporate treasurers and capital markets participants seeking more efficient collateral.
Hannah Winter, BlackRock’s head of digital cash, said the ability to make peer-to-peer transfers had appealed to companies exploring intracompany payments.
BlackRock previously entered the tokenized cash-management market with BUIDL, its US dollar-denominated institutional liquidity fund, in 2024. The fund has since grown to $2.67 billion in assets, according to RWA.xyz.

summary: The a16z-backed studio will open-source Pirate Nation assets, while an independent foundation continues supporting the PIRATE token.
full_text:
Proof of Play to shut down after blockchain gaming thesis falls short
The a16z-backed studio will open-source Pirate Nation assets, while an independent foundation continues supporting the PIRATE token.
Blockchain game developer Proof of Play will cease operations after failing to build a sustainable business around its decentralized gaming thesis.
The a16z-backed studio said Tuesday it could not develop a product that proved blockchain-based games could help usher in a decentralized internet at scale. It will open-source much of its code and artwork, including the Pirate Nation game, smart contracts and internal software-development tools.
Proof of Play said the independent Pirate Nation Foundation will continue supporting the PIRATE token and keep its website operational. However, Proof of Play points will not be redeemable for anything.
The studio also made the artwork and intellectual property associated with the Founder Pirates non-fungible tokens and Pirate Nation available under a CC0 license. Its Shiba Story Go! game was acquired by an unidentified third party and will continue operating independently.
At their peak, Proof of Play’s Apex and Boss networks were the two largest gas consumers tracked across Ethereum’s rollup ecosystem

title: Forgd brings its crypto market-maker leaderboard to DefiLlama
summary: Forgd’s ratings draw on data from more than 500 token projects and 35 market-making firms, but do not solely reflect trading performance.
full_text:
Forgd brings its crypto market-maker leaderboard to DefiLlama
Forgd’s ratings draw on data from more than 500 token projects and 35 market-making firms, but do not solely reflect trading performance.
Crypto analytics platform DefiLlama has integrated Forgd’s market-maker leaderboard, giving users access to data on spreads, market depth, trading volume and uptime.
In an announcement sent to Cointelegraph, Forgd said that the dashboard ranks crypto market makers using standardized measures of pricing, depth, reliability and execution quality. The data comes from more than 500 token projects and 35 market-making firms that use Forgd’s tools to monitor liquidity across active engagements, according to the company.
The integration allows DefiLlama users to compare market makers across exchanges and assess the liquidity supporting individual tokens. Forgd first launched the leaderboard in May as a tool for token projects selecting and monitoring liquidity providers.
Ryan Celaj, DefiLlama’s head of research, said the integration adds another signal for evaluating execution quality and market resilience alongside metrics such as volume and liquidity.
However, the ratings do not solely reflect observed trading performance. “A lower grade on the index is not necessarily a judgment of a firm’s trading,” Forgd CEO Shane Molidor told Cointelegraph.
“It reflects that they haven’t yet fully opted into performance verification.” This means that the leaderboard ratings may also reflect the amount of data a market maker provides to Forgd.
Forgd and DefiLlama did not disclose financial terms for the integration. Cointelegraph reached out for further comment.

title: Boerse Stuttgart Digital, Tradias close European crypto merger
summary: The completed tie-up combines Boerse Stuttgart Digital’s custody business with Tradias’ trading operations under a joint management team.
full_text:
Boerse Stuttgart Digital, Tradias close European crypto merger
The completed tie-up combines Boerse Stuttgart Digital’s custody business with Tradias’ trading operations under a joint management team.
Boerse Stuttgart Digital and institutional crypto trading firm Tradias have completed their merger after clearing the required ownership control procedure, creating a combined digital asset infrastructure unit with about 300 employees.
The transaction was first announced in February, when the companies agreed to combine their regulated crypto businesses and expand their services for banks, brokers and other financial institutions across Europe.
The merged business will operate under the Boerse Stuttgart Digital name, while Tradias will remain the brand for trading services, according to a Wednesday announcement.
The unit will provide trading, custody, staking and tokenization services and will be headquartered in Frankfurt and Stuttgart, with additional locations in Athens, Beirut, Berlin, Dubai, Madrid, Milan and Ljubljana.
Tradias founder Christopher Beck and Boerse Stuttgart Digital managing director Ulli Spankowski will serve as co-CEOs.
Boerse Stuttgart Digital serves institutions including DZ Bank, DekaBank, Intesa Sanpaolo and Société Générale-FORGE. Tradias works with clients including flatexDEGIRO, dwpbank and European government institutions.
Tradias provides trading and market-making services for more than 150 cryptocurrencies and other digital assets. Financial terms of the transaction were not disclosed.

MiCA list expands with 12 companies in fourth post-deadline update
ESMA’s latest MiCA update brings the number of authorized CASPs to 321 and adds three entities to its non-compliant register.
The European Securities and Markets Authority (ESMA) added 12 companies to its Markets in Crypto-Assets (MiCA) register in its fourth update since the July 1 transitional deadline.
Published on July 31, the update brings the total number of authorized crypto-asset service providers (CASPs) listed under MiCA to 321. The latest additions include three German cooperative banks: Volksbank Raiffeisenbank Oberbayern Südost, VR Bank Schleswig-Holstein Mitte and VR-Bank Landau-Mengkofen.
The list also includes two companies in Spain — Basque Pay and Fintech Payments — and four in France — Finary, Woorton, Blockchain Process Security and Shares Financial Assets.
Twelve CASPs added in ESMA’s July 31 MiCA register update. Source: ESMA
ESMA’s update also added three companies to its non-compliant entities register: Cervo Rendisco, Flandenzo and Corona Fondenza, flagged by Italy’s Commissione Nazionale per le Società e la Borsa (CONSOB). The non-compliant entities register now includes 167 entries.
The latest update did not include changes to other MiCA-related registers. The number of authorized e-money token (EMT) issuers remains at 41, while no asset-referenced token (ART) issuers are currently listed on the register.

title: Taiwan plans Travel Rule for domestic crypto transfers from October
summary: Taiwan’s regulator plans to apply the Travel Rule to domestic VASP transfers from October before extending it to overseas platforms by the end of 2027.
full_text:
Taiwan plans Travel Rule for domestic crypto transfers from October
Taiwan’s regulator plans to apply the Travel Rule to domestic VASP transfers from October before extending it to overseas platforms by the end of 2027.
Taiwan’s financial regulator plans to require crypto platforms to transmit customer information on all domestic platform-to-platform transfers starting in October.
On Tuesday, the Financial Supervisory Commission said its proposed amendments would apply the Financial Action Task Force’s (FATF) Travel Rule regardless of value.
Transfers exceeding 30,000 New Taiwan dollars (about $930) would trigger additional data requirements, including an individual sender’s date of birth and residential address, or a corporate sender’s official identification number and registered address. Receiving VASPs would also be required to compare beneficiary information supplied by the originating platform with their own records.
The FSC plans to extend the framework to transfers between domestic and overseas VASPs by the end of 2027.
Taiwan introduced Travel Rule provisions in its AML regulations in 2021 but did not implement them, citing differences among countries’ regulatory requirements, incompatible information-transmission standards and difficulties connecting cross-border systems. The FSC said the proposed amendments would soon enter a 30-day public consultation.
The proposal comes as Travel Rule adoption advances globally but remains uneven. In July, the FATF said 83% of surveyed jurisdictions had enacted Travel Rule legislation, up from 73% in 2025, while warning that significant implementation and enforcement gaps remained.
Related: Taiwan’s legislature passes crypto, stablecoin regulations

title: Missouri trio charged over alleged Bitcoin kidnapping plot

Missouri trio charged over alleged Bitcoin kidnapping plot
The defendants allegedly traveled from Missouri to Connecticut to kidnap a Bitcoin holder and force him to transfer cryptocurrency before abandoning the plan.
Three Missouri men were charged over an alleged August 2024 plot to kidnap a Bitcoin holder and steal his holdings.
Sedric Louis, John Davis and Martel Williams were allegedly hired to kidnap and force a Bitcoin holder to transfer cryptocurrency to accounts controlled by organizers, according to a Tuesday press release by the US Attorney’s Office. They traveled from St. Louis to Connecticut, where they rented vehicles and obtained air rifles to stake out the victim.
After staking out the intended target for two days, they abandoned the plan for fear of being caught on home security cameras. Shortly afterward, another crew from Florida arrived to carry out the plan.
The three were charged with conspiracy to interfere with commerce by robbery under the Hobbs Act, which carries a maximum sentence of 20 years. Louis and Davis have been detained since their arrest on June 25, 2026. Williams was released on bond. All three pleaded not guilty.
Home invasions were the most common type of physical attack targeting cryptocurrency investors in the first half of 2026, according to blockchain security company CertiK. Crypto home invasions rose to 20 reported incidents in H1, up from a single case a year earlier.

title: Cipher slides 16% on wider Q2 losses as Bernstein sees upside from Texas power audit
summary: The bitcoin miner-turned-HPC developer posted a net loss of $267.5 million in Q2, more than five times the loss it registered a year ago.
full_text:
Cipher slides 16% on wider Q2 losses as Bernstein sees upside from Texas power audit
Quick Take
- Cipher Digital shares tumbled 15.7% on Tuesday after the company announced wider losses in the second quarter of this year.
- Bernstein maintained its Outperform rating and a $32 price target, citing potential Texas power audit upside.
We'd love your feedback.
Cipher Digital (CIFR) shares fell 15.7% on Tuesday after the bitcoin (BTC) miner reported wider losses in the second quarter of this year.
The bitcoin miner-turned-HPC developer posted a net loss of $267.5 million in the second quarter, more than five times the loss it registered a year ago, according to its Q2 report released Tuesday. It posted $24.8 million in revenue in the quarter, down from $43.6 million in Q2 2025.
The company also said that it delivered its first Black Pearl data center capacity at the beginning of August, roughly two months ahead of schedule.
"A core strength of our strategy is its repeatability, and in the second quarter, we demonstrated that once again," said Tyler Page, CEO of Cipher. "We accessed capital markets to fund another one of our leases, secured an option on a new site, and delivered accelerated capacity to our tenant, further building our position as a leading HPC development platform."
Despite the weaker quarterly results, Bernstein analysts reiterated their "Outperform" rating for Cipher in a Wednesday note to clients, saying execution remains on track across the company's three contracted data center projects with full delivery expected by the first half of 2027.
Bernstein also maintained its $32 price target, indicating an upside of 57%. Cipher shares closed at $20.38 on Tuesday, according to The Block's CIFR price page.
Texas audit
Bernstein also said a new Texas initiative could ultimately benefit established bitcoin miners and HPC developers such as Cipher.
On Monday, Texas Governor Greg Abbott directed the Public Utility Commission of Texas and grid operator ERCOT to audit all data center projects currently in the state's interconnection queue, prompting ERCOT to pause its "Batch Zero" process. The process was set to classify the first group of large electricity users later this month.
According to Bernstein, the move is likely to curb speculative data center development, increase the scarcity value of already-approved power capacity, and boost existing bitcoin miners and AI operators.
"We believe the new Texas directive could push out the Batch Zero pipeline conversion by a few months, however it ultimately benefits credible developers like Cipher by decongesting the grid queue from speculative burden," the analysts said Wednesday.
Like several other bitcoin miners, Cipher has been pivoting away from a pure-play mining business toward leasing data center capacity to AI and cloud providers. The company held $37.8 million worth of bitcoin at the end of June, compared to $125.4 million at the end of last year.

title: Former LAPD officer gets life sentence for kidnapping teen in $350,000 bitcoin robbery: report
summary: Former LAPD officer Eric Halem was sentenced to life plus 15 years for kidnapping teen and stealing $350,000 in bitcoin.
full_text:
Former LAPD officer gets life sentence for kidnapping teen in $350,000 bitcoin robbery: report
Quick Take
- A former LAPD officer was sentenced to life in prison plus 15 years for kidnapping and robbing a 17-year-old of a hard drive containing $350,000 in bitcoin, the Los Angeles Times reported.
We'd love your feedback.
Former LAPD officer Eric Halem was sentenced to life plus 15 years in state prison on Tuesday for his role in the December 2024 armed robbery of a 17-year-old in Koreatown, who was robbed of a hard drive containing $350,000 worth of bitcoin.
Los Angeles County Superior Court Judge Mildred Escobedo imposed the concurrent life terms for kidnapping and robbery after rejecting a last-ditch request by defense attorneys seeking a new trial, the Los Angeles Times reported.
Halem had sought a new trial on grounds that his initial attorneys failed to call witnesses or examine key evidence. However, Judge Escobedo denied that motion, noting that the evidence presented at trial showed Halem had acted out of "sheer and utter greed," adding that "there could've been no other conclusion."
According to a district attorney's spokesperson, Halem must complete most of his 15-year sentence before serving the concurrent life terms and will be eligible for parole after seven years.
Halem was convicted in March following a two-week trial in which a jury found him guilty of kidnapping and robbery. Prosecutors said Halem and three co-conspirators entered a high-rise apartment and forced the victim, identified in court as Daniel, to hand over the hard drive under threat of death.
Halem had left the LAPD nearly two years before the robbery but was still serving as a reserve officer at the time, according to the LA Times.
He still faces pending charges in separate cases involving insurance fraud and another alleged crypto-related robbery, while his co-defendants have yet to stand trial, per the report.

title: Ex-LAPD Officer Gets Life Plus 15 Years Over $350K Bitcoin Robbery
summary: Eric Halem and his crew wore police vests to enter a Koreatown high-rise, then handcuffed a 17-year-old and took his hard drive.
full_text:
In brief
- A Los Angeles judge handed ex-LAPD officer Eric Halem concurrent life terms for kidnapping and robbery, rejecting his bid for a new trial.
- Halem’s crew entered the victim’s apartment using an access code obtained from a conspirator who had rented it.
- Halem still faces charges over insurance fraud and a second crypto robbery days earlier.
A former Los Angeles police officer was sentenced Tuesday to life plus 15 years in state prison for a home invasion in which $350,000 in Bitcoin was taken from a teenager, the Los Angeles Times reported.
Eric Halem, 38, was found guilty in March of kidnapping and robbery after a two-week trial, with jurors returning a verdict in under a day. Superior Court Judge Mildred Escobedo rejected a late bid for a new trial before imposing concurrent life terms, saying the evidence showed a man prepared to use violence out of "sheer and utter greed." He becomes eligible for parole after seven years, according to the district attorney's office.
Prosecutors said Halem and three other men entered a Koreatown apartment at around 2:30 a.m. on December 28, 2024, handcuffed two victims, moved funds out of their cryptocurrency account and took cash and jewellery. The men arrived in a Range Rover and a Lamborghini Urus registered to Halem's car rental business, wore vests identifying them as police, and let themselves in with an access code supplied by a conspirator who had rented the unit.
Halem had left the department nearly two years earlier after 13 years of service, though he was still a reserve officer at the time.
The 17-year-old, who testified under his first name only, had built his holdings partly by scamming others. Escobedo said that did not excuse the crime, and that a former officer masquerading as police to rob someone was "heinous and egregious."
Halem's family disputes the outcome. His mother Randi told the paper she believed the truth had not emerged at trial, calling it "a miscarriage of the law."
Luis Banuelos, Pierre Louis and Mishael Mann were each charged in August 2025 with kidnapping for ransom, first-degree residential robbery and home invasion robbery in concert. All pleaded not guilty, have yet to stand trial and maintain their innocence.
Halem faces further charges over insurance fraud and a second crypto robbery said to have taken place days before the Koreatown raid. Those remain allegations.
Fake badges, and real ones
So-called "wrench attacks," where criminals use violence to coerce crypto holders, are on the rise globally. CertiK verified 52 wrench attacks worldwide in the first half of 2026, with recorded losses of $124.1 million. Remy St. Felix was sentenced to 47 years in September 2024 for running a violent crypto home-invasion ring, at the time the longest term handed down in a U.S. crypto case.
Impersonating police has become a recurring technique for crypto criminals. Three men posing as officers held a French couple at knifepoint in March, forcing a $1 million Bitcoin transfer, and a 32-year-old was indicted in Nancy in June over a similar attack on a couple whose holdings had been exposed in a data breach. In Ukraine, prosecutors in May accused four police officers and a civilian of kidnapping crypto entrepreneurs at gunpoint and extorting $2.2 million using fabricated debt claims.

title: Viral Mugshot Accounts Are Ruining Women’s Lives
summary: Mugshawtys and similar pages often frame mugshots as thirst traps. The women featured are humiliated and are sometimes harassed for months and years after their arrests.
full_text:
About a month after Megan Davis’ biological mother died of a drug overdose in July 2025, she went out for drinks with a friend in Northgate, a cluster of bars in College Station, Texas.
She downed a couple of shots and got into an altercation with another group of patrons after bumping into them, according to Davis and body camera footage. Security at the bar kicked Davis out and called the police, who charged her with public intoxication, resulting in an overnight jail stay and a $450 fine.
“Right before my mugshot was taken, I had a panic attack,” says Davis, who was 23 at the time. “I knew I made a big mistake.” After being released the next morning, she set up a payment plan for the fine, and put the incident behind her.
Beginning the day of her arrest, on August 21, 2025, Davis' mugshot started going viral. It was first posted to the Facebook page SayCheese Brazos County Mugshots & Arrests, one of about a dozen Texas-specific mugshot pages under the SayCheese brand, then turned into a hoax on Facebook, alleging she was an Olive Garden waitress who’d been arrested for throwing breadsticks at a customer over tips. Then, on October 12, 2025, her mugshot appeared on Mugshawtys, a popular Instagram account that posts mugshots of young women, often framed as thirst traps.
Thousands of people have now commented—and harshly judged—Davis’ looks and character; when Mugshawtys reposted her photo in a roundup in June, a man wrote in comment on the post “I bet there [sic] parents are proud of them.” Davis replied underneath that her mother had died weeks before the mugshot was taken. “I hope she’s proud of what I’ve done to better myself since this happened,” she wrote.
Almost a year later, Davis is still wading through the fallout. “All that this has been for me is just being dragged through the mud,” Davis says, adding that she’s taken “full accountability” for the incident.
“I just don't understand where we are going to draw a line with social media and privacy.”
Mugshawtys was started around a decade ago by Josh Jeffery, a 31-year-old electrician in California. Up until very recently, it had about 1.8 million Instagram followers, including many loyal, mostly male fans—some of whom trawl arrest bookings and mugshot sites to send in submissions. The brand, which gained a million followers after being featured on Joe Rogan’s podcast last year, according to Jeffery, also had 19,000 Facebook followers and currently has nearly half a million on X.
Within the last week, in response to a list of questions from WIRED, both Meta and TikTok disabled Mugshawtys accounts on their respective platforms. A Meta spokesperson said the account breached multiple policies, pointing WIRED to its community standards page. A TikTok US spokesperson declined to comment on why the account was removed. Jeffery did not respond to a request for comment about the removals. X did not reply to a request for comment.
Jeffery says he’s friends with some of the girls he features on the page—and claims he’s not trying to exploit them. “A lot of them end up doing some form of OnlyFans or content creation or something,” he claims, adding that he encourages Mugshawtys followers to chip in for the women's bail or legal fees.
But the pages are rife with sexual fantasies and misogynistic jokes. “They don’t have to be old enough to drink, just old enough to swallow,” read one comment under an Instagram post featuring a woman arrested for underage drinking. Under carousel posts of mugshots, men wrote comments like “mid,” “that’s a man,” “6 at best,” sometimes ranking women in order of who they find attractive. Last summer, Mugshawtys’ Instagram account posted a photo of a woman who appears to be wearing an anti-suicide smock. The caption stated she had been arrested for alleged child endangerment. The gloved hand of a jail official is seen holding her head while she grimaces and pulls away from the camera. A comment underneath read "child abuse i hope the guards pushed her head to other places." The caption mislabeled the woman’s charges, and the case was ultimately disposed. But many commenters seem unaware that the existence of a mugshot is not an admittance of guilt.
As the brand has grown more popular, Jeffery even sells merch like T-shirts and hats with text that reads “i [heart] hot felons” for about $10. In 2024, small Amsterdam publisher 550BC made a Mugshawtys coffee table book, which Jeffery has since sold online. 550BC did not respond to a request for comment.
That those featured on Mugshawtys are all captured in a vulnerable state—many are disheveled, intoxicated, or appear to be crying—often seems to appeal to followers of the accounts. “You see a woman in the worst kind of condition that she might have found herself in without perfect makeup, being absolutely vulnerable, being held by the state,” sociologist Danielle Dirks tells WIRED. “Some men think this is the perfect time to seize upon them.”
Jeffery says he believes if anyone is exploiting women, it’s the justice system, and that he will remove a mugshot if a woman asks him to: “I'll take down anything. Especially if they didn't submit it themselves, then I'm more quick to do it.”
Early mugshots were primarily used as a law enforcement tool for alerting a community about a potential offender or for gathering tips, says Sarah Lageson, an associate professor of law and criminology at Northeastern University. Journalists could go down to a police station and flip through booklets of them, a process that required existing relationships with law enforcement or press credentials. Digitization made the images publicly accessible, and online mugshots became a cultural phenomenon in the mid-aughts, with pay-for-removal websites—which publish people’s mugshots then request a fee to remove them—taking off. But mugshot laws vary by state, leading to confusion for someone seeking removal of their image. For example, Oregon prohibits law enforcement agencies from releasing mugshots prior to a conviction; in Florida, a state with lenient open records laws, there are no guardrails on social media usage, but mugshot sites must remove a person’s mugshot, if requested, at no charge.
Navigating the legalese around mugshots can be daunting. “People are so exhausted by the mugshot itself, they often don't want to litigate and put their name back in the public record attached to mugshots,” says Lageson.
Now, amid the explosion of video across all social media platforms, YouTubers and social media accounts have expanded to body cam footage, with some creators accessing the footage through Freedom of Information Act requests.
In March 2026, bodycam footage from Davis’ arrest was posted to a YouTube called Sgt. Pepperspray. The footage shows her wearing a black crop top, visibly panicked and intoxicated. Viewers left linked timestamps in the comments redirecting to moments in the video when close-up shots of just Davis’ breasts were visible onscreen. (Davis contacted YouTube’s legal support team via a defamation claim which was denied. A rep for YouTube said that Davis would need to file a privacy complaint.)
“They're just really vivid public shaming tools in my view,” Lageson says.
But not everyone is opposed to the attention. Jeffery says some women submit their own photos or tag themselves in the comments to redirect traffic to their own page.
“It gave me a little bit of an ego boost,” says Holly Singleton, a 22-year-old in Indiana, whose mugshot was featured on the account on March 11. “I’m not bothered by it. Unfortunately, social media is forever,”
Most women posted to Mugshawtys are white and appear to be college-aged. In a study published in 2015 in the Contemporary Justice Review, Dirks wrote that white women are often viewed as “victims of circumstance deserving of empathy and redemption rather than as criminals.” But Dirks tells WIRED that in the case of Mugshawtys, the focus on conventional beauty standards can render these women more visibl

title: 3 Best Tracking Devices for Your Keys, Wallet, and More (2026)
summary: Lose something? Here are the best Bluetooth trackers to avoid pocket-patting panic.
full_text:
I'd like to believe I'm organized. Reality suggests otherwise. I've left my smartphone in the refrigerator and spent hours searching for it. I've misplaced my AirPods and Oura Ring for days at a time. I once lost my house key for three months, only to find it in one of my hoodies. My typical strategy isn't to look harder; it's to assume whatever's missing will eventually reappear someday.
The problem is, lost items don't always cooperate. Even seasoned travelers know that once luggage disappears onto an airport conveyor belt, all you can do is hope. That's why Bluetooth trackers are essential. Yes, there are legitimate privacy concerns around tracking devices and misuse. But without Bluetooth and GPS trackers, I'd spend considerably more of my life wandering around my apartment wondering, “Where did I put that?”
These are the best Bluetooth trackers WIRED has tested and vetted. Still confused about how these devices work? We have more information on how to find your phone, how to track your luggage, and the best trackable luggage.
Love WIRED? Add us as a preferred source on Google to see more of us.
Featured in This Guide
Updated August 2026: I've added the UAG Metropolis Card and the Peak Design Beacon Finder Card. I've retested the Pebblebee Clip 5 and Card 5. Prices and links were also updated.
How I Test Tracking Devices
To find the best Bluetooth trackers, I use them as part of my daily routine, attaching them to the things I often misplace.
- Design and build: I tend to favor compact, lightweight trackers that are simple to stash or attach to a keychain or everyday items.
- Setup: I evaluate how easy trackers are to pair, whether apps are intuitive, and whether privacy features work as advertised.
- Bluetooth range: A longer range means you can be farther from your tracker and still find what you've misplaced. I test how far trackers remain connected in open outdoor spaces, dense cities, and buildings with interference. I also test them during air travel, monitoring how often locator notifications come through when they're separated from my phone for longer periods.
- Battery performance: I note how long replaceable batteries actually last and how easy they are to swap when they die. For rechargeable trackers, I test battery life and charging speed against manufacturer claims.
- Compatibility: Some trackers work best for iPhone users, some are better for Android users, while others support both platforms equally well.
- Privacy and security: I look for trackers with end-to-end encrypted detection networks to protect location data from being easily accessed or misused. Ideally, they should also mask their identity so third parties can't use them to follow you.
What Am I Testing Next?
I'm testing the Motorola Moto Tag, Samsung Galaxy SmartTag2, the LandAirSea 54 GPS Tracker, the Tracki Universal, and the Nomad Tracking Card Air. I'm also reevaluating all trackers in the Chipolo collection.
Best Bluetooth Tracker Overall
In the competition between Tile and Chipolo for the most ubiquitous tracker, I would not have guessed that Chipolo would be the one to land exclusive collaborations with both Apple and Google (cough, antitrust congressional hearings, cough). Yet here we are.
Why WIRED recommends: Chipolo has three separate product lines: the Chipolo Pop, Loop, and Card, plus bundles that work with the Chipolo app; all products are compatible with iOS and Android devices (and their respective tracking apps, Apple Find My and Android Find Hub) , and they have an IP67 rating against dust and water. WIRED editor Julian Chokkattu and I have tested several of these lines. They're at a similar price point to Tile's and come in a variety of colors. Setup is simple, especially if you use your phone's native app. I currently have a Card in my wallet. It's about the same size as one credit card and about as thick as two of them. It's also loud enough for me to hear even when it's in my wallet, inside my purse, and in another room. Like with the Tile, you can choose to get left-behind alerts if you leave the house without your keys.
The trade-offs: As with many trackers, the connection can get wonky—I sometimes have to walk around a bit—but it's usually able to find an accurate last location. —Adrienne So
Best for Apple Devices
Apple's long-awaited Tile competitor debuted in 2021; AirTags use Bluetooth connectivity and the company's special U1 location-finding chip to help you pinpoint location via the Apple Find My app.
Why WIRED recommends: AirTags are about the size of a quarter, and you can attach them to almost anything with an AirTag case or key clip. You can slip one into your luggage when you travel, or hide it in your bike. The Find My network is giant, anonymous, and encrypted end-to-end. Through the app, you'll receive visual, audio, and haptic feedback as your iPhone guides you to your lost item. title: A New Device Eases One of the Most Annoying Parts of Routine Physicals
summary: Nobody likes getting a swab shoved up their nose. A startup in Japan has developed a much less intrusive system.
full_text:
When a doctor examines a patient's throat, they use a process that’s been handed down pretty much unchanged since ancient times. It’s one of the most fundamental components of the physical exam, alongside measuring body temperature and listening to a heartbeat. However, the patterns of findings that appear in the throat differ depending on the pathogen, and an enormous amount of information lies hidden there. A Japanese company called Iris, led by Sho Okuyama, is seeking to unlock that information using artificial intelligence.
The system developed by Iris, Nodoca, uses AI to analyze images of the pharynx captured with a compact camera-equipped device, together with information from the patient's medical interview and other data, and returns an influenza assessment in a little over 10 seconds. It eliminates the need for the conventional test—one that is prone to causing discomfort because it requires inserting a swab deep into the nose to collect a nasal specimen—and can also be used at an earlier stage after symptom onset.
In 2022, it became the first AI-equipped medical device in Japan to receive approval as a “new medical device” and gain coverage under the national health insurance system. It has since been introduced at more than 2,000 medical institutions across Japan. In October 2025, it also received approval for an additional function related to Covid-19.
Okuyama is a former emergency physician who also has experience practicing medicine on remote islands. On an island with only a few hundred residents, the only medical equipment available was essentially a stethoscope, and he says he had to rely on his own eyes and ears to treat patients.
“When people hear ‘medical AI,’ they tend to think of the part that makes diagnoses,” Okuyama says. “But the real differentiating factor lies in sensing—how the data is acquired. We developed our own hardware and ventured into the area of pharyngeal images, which no one had touched.”
When the company was founded in 2017, there was no training data for AI focused on the throat. Okuyama therefore lent dedicated cameras to around 100 medical institutions and, over the course of about three years, collected data with patients’ consent. By overcoming three major uncertainties—the development of the hardware, the collection of training data, and whether AI-assisted diagnosis could truly be made to work—the company opened the path to practical implementation.
Once Nodoca had been commercialized, its accuracy improved at an accelerating pace. Every time it is used in clinical practice, anonymized processed data are accumulated. The number of throat images, which had been in the hundreds of thousands before launch, has now grown to several million. This network effect has become a barrier to entry for competitors, and no latecomers have emerged in the same field.
The potential of Nodoca extends beyond infectious diseases. Images of the throat capture patterns in the mucosa and blood vessels, and the company is also conducting research and development on AI capable of detecting lifestyle-related diseases such as diabetes and hypertension by identifying changes in those patterns.
“I think that in about 10 years, we'll reach an era in which a single photograph of the throat can be used to perform a comprehensive range of tests,” Okuyama says. “The cost of AI inference is extremely low, so even if we increase the number of tests, the cost of providing them hardly changes.”
The Goal of “Redesigning” Health Care
Looking further ahead, Okuyama is considering whether AI can serve as the foundation for redesigning health care itself. AI-powered medical interviews and online consultations have already become a reality, followed by in-person care from primary care physicians and treatment at specialist hospitals. Okuyama envisions a future in which AI is implemented at every stage of that process.
To make this AI-driven redesign of health care a reality, Okuyama has also been actively proposing regulatory reform and lobbying government ministries.
“The ‘future of health care’ that I talk about doesn't actually include a single future technology,” he says. “Everything can be achieved with technology that already exists today. Our job is to close the gap that makes these things have to be talked about as ‘the future.’”
Because the body's mucous membranes are believed to be highly consistent, Okuyama says the data and algorithms accumulated in Japan are expected to be transferable elsewhere. Preparations for overseas expansion are already underway, with clinical trials in the United States also under consideration.
This story originally appeared on WIRED Japan and has been translated from Japanese.

title: Hashdex Will Liquidate DEFI in the First Wind-Down of a U.S. Spot Bitcoin ETF
summary:
Hashdex is closing its $14.3 million spot bitcoin ETF after Aug. 17, in what looks like the first liquidation of a U.S. fund holding bitcoin directly.

The post Hashdex Will Liquidate DEFI in the First Wind-Down of a U.S. Spot Bitcoin ETF appeared first on Unchained.
full_text:
Hashdex Asset Management will close and liquidate the Hashdex Bitcoin ETF, which trades on NYSE Arca under the ticker DEFI, the sponsor said in a Monday announcement. It is the first U.S. spot bitcoin ETF to be wound down since the category launched in January 2024.
The fund most recently held about $14.5 million, according to SoSoValue. Shareholders can sell on the exchange through the close of business on August 17, after which the fund stops accepting creation orders from authorized participants and delists. Anyone still holding receives a cash liquidating distribution expected on or about August 28, set at net asset value and reflecting closing costs plus any move in bitcoin while the fund sells its holdings. Hashdex cited assets under management, trading liquidity, operating costs, investor interest, and the fund’s fit within its index-based product range.
This story is an excerpt from the Unchained Daily newsletter.
Subscribe here to get these updates in your email for free
Hashdex launched DEFI as a bitcoin futures product in September 2022 and converted it to spot in late March 2024, nearly three months after IBIT began trading, and its 0.25% expense ratio at the time matched what BlackRock and Fidelity charged. WisdomTree’s BTCW, the next-smallest fund, holds $143 million; IBIT holds $47.65 billion and has taken $60.5 billion of lifetime inflows. Hashdex is not leaving the U.S. market and still manages more than $200 million across remaining products, including the Hashdex Nasdaq Crypto Index US ETF.
VanEck shut a bitcoin futures ETF in 2024, and Cosmos Asset Management delisted Australian bitcoin and ether ETFs in November 2022 after they gathered about 1.1 million Australian dollars 1between them.

title: Six Ethereum Researchers Propose Burning Validator Rewards to Zero Issuance at a 50% Staking Ratio
summary:
A draft EIP from six researchers including Justin Drake would burn a growing share of validator rewards, cancelling consensus issuance once half of all ETH is staked.

The post Six Ethereum Researchers Propose Burning Validator Rewards to Zero Issuance at a 50% Staking Ratio appeared first on Unchained.
full_text:
Six Ethereum researchers and developers published a draft improvement proposal on Tuesday that would burn a rising share of validator rewards, removing the protocol’s issuance incentive to stake more than half of all ETH. The authors are lead writer pintail, Ethereum France President Jérôme de Tychey, Ethereum core developer dapplion, pa7x1, researchers Ladislaus von Daniels and Justin Drake.
At each epoch boundary, every validator is charged a fraction of the idealized reward for each duty it was assigned, whether attestation, block proposal, or sync committee work, and that ETH is destroyed. The fraction scales with total stake and reaches 100% at a fixed 60,250,000 ETH, roughly half the current supply, at which point a performing validator’s consensus issuance nets to zero. Execution-layer income is untouched, so fees and MEV keep flowing.
This story is an excerpt from the Unchained Daily newsletter.
Subscribe here to get these updates in your email for free
For holders, the proposal is a trade between dilution and yield. Issuance would peak near a 19.8% staking ratio and fall after it rather than climbing without limit, capping the dilution paid by unstaked ETH. Stakers absorb the cost: applied in full at today’s ratio, the burn would cut net consensus yield from about 2.6% to 1.2%, which is why the authors phase it in by temporarily doubling the base reward factor to 128 and decaying it back to today’s 64 over roughly 18 months. The curve’s shape applies from the first epoch after activation, so growth beyond 50% stops being rewarded immediately.
DeFi’s response has been hostile. Aave founder Stani Kulechov wrote that the proposal “doesn’t achieve the outcome it tries to achieve and is actually hurtful for Ethereum.” ether.fi CEO Silagadze said the change would push out solo stakers who are not subsidized and leave staking to large centralized operators with no cost of capital.
Timing is the other objection. The draft landed two days before the August 6 deadline for submitting EIPs to the Hegota upgrade.

title: Cloudflare Opens Stablecoin Wallet Handles as It Builds the Buy Side of Agent Payments
summary:
Cloudflare is rolling out Account Wallets for humans and Virtual Wallets for AI agents, settling in stablecoins over x402, with funding still to come.

The post Cloudflare Opens Stablecoin Wallet Handles as It Builds the Buy Side of Agent Payments appeared first on Unchained.
full_text:
Cloudflare began rolling out stablecoin wallets for AI agents on Tuesday, opening the identity layer of a product that will eventually let software buy APIs, MCP tools, and web content without a human approving each purchase. Account holders can claim a wallet handle at cloudflare.pay now. Funding and spending arrive later.
The design separates humans from machines. Account Wallets belong to people and organizations, which add funds, delegate spending, and withdraw. Virtual Wallets are issued to agents and operate through API keys, with the owner setting an allowance, an allow list, and a maximum transaction size. Payments settle in stablecoins over x402, the open protocol that attaches payment instructions to an ordinary HTTP request and returns a 402 Payment Required response carrying the price.
This story is an excerpt from the Unchained Daily newsletter.
Subscribe here to get these updates in your email for free
Cloudflare says it fronts about one in five websites, and it now controls both sides of the transaction after opening the waitlist for its Monetization Gateway, which lets site owners charge per request, on July 1. Every merchant that switches the gateway on becomes somewhere these wallets can spend.
Cloudflare commits to onramps and offramps in supported geographies, with self-funding via stablecoins for eligible users.
Cloudflare announced the x402 Foundation with Coinbase last September, added x402 support to its Agents SDK and MCP servers, and has worked with Visa, Mastercard, and American Express on standards for identifying trusted agents. The Linux Foundation agreed to host the standard earlier this year, and Stripe and Paradigm’s Tempo chain shipped a competing agent payment protocol in March.

title: Warren and Blumenthal Ask SEC to Investigate Trump’s Memecoin as Clarity Act Stalls Over Ethics
summary:
Two Senate Democrats want the SEC to examine $3.81 billion in $TRUMP losses, filing the request in the week that decides the Clarity Act's fate.

The post Warren and Blumenthal Ask SEC to Investigate Trump’s Memecoin as Clarity Act Stalls Over Ethics appeared first on Unchained.
full_text:
Senators Elizabeth Warren and Richard Blumenthal asked the Securities and Exchange Commission on Monday to investigate $TRUMP, the memecoin President Donald Trump promoted three days before his inauguration. In a letter to SEC Chair Paul Atkins, the two Democrats said the token’s collapse warrants scrutiny for possible fraud and unjust enrichment.
The senators built their case on the gap between what buyers lost and what the president earned. Nearly a million investors lost about $3.81 billion on $TRUMP from its January 2025 debut through the end of June, they wrote, citing New York Times reporting, while Trump made $636 million from the token. $TRUMP traded above $74 at its peak and changes hands near $1.47 now, down roughly 98%. The letter also points to a July 27 Senate Permanent Subcommittee on Investigations minority staff report collecting accounts from buyers who described the project as abandoned.
This story is an excerpt from the Unchained Daily newsletter.
Subscribe here to get these updates in your email for free
The SEC said in February 2025 that memecoins lack meaningful use and generally do not qualify as securities, effectively removing them from its remit.
The letter comes in the week that decides whether the Digital Asset Market Clarity Act moves or waits until after the midterms, and one of the major fights holding the bill up is the ethics section covering Trump’s conduct.
Negotiators are still waiting. Senators Thom Tillis, a Republican, and Ruben Gallego, a Democrat, sent the White House a tougher version of the provision barring senior officials from direct involvement in crypto projects last week, and the administration had not responded days later, according to reporting by Crypto in America’s Eleanor Terrett. Thune wants to start the Senate’s voting process this week, before the August recess. Without a deal that brings as many as 10 Democrats along, a floor vote risks failing outright.
Warren, the ranking Democrat on the Senate Banking Committee, has opposed the bill throughout and sits outside the negotiations; she pressed Senate leaders in July to add ethics language after Trump’s financial disclosure showed more than $1.4 billion in crypto income. The House passed its version 294-134 in July 2025, and the Banking Committee advanced the Senate text 15-9 in May. If Democrats retake the Senate in November, Warren would likely chair the committee that oversees the SEC.

title: CLARITY 法案本週闖關失敗？Bitwise：加密產業不會停下，潘朵拉寶盒已開
summary:
Polymarket 顯示 CLARITY 法案 2026 年過關機率僅 27%，遠低於 2 月的 82%。B […]

〈CLARITY 法案本週闖關失敗？Bitwise：加密產業不會停下，潘朵拉寶盒已開〉這篇文章最早發佈於動區BlockTempo《動區動趨-最具影響力的區塊鏈新聞媒體》。
full_text:
Polymarket 顯示 CLARITY 法案 2026 年過關機率僅 27%，遠低於 2 月的 82%。Bitwise 分析師 Matt Hougan 指出，即便本週參議院闖關失敗，法案將進入「殭屍狀態」，但加密產業不會因此停滯，SEC 可接手監管，且產業動能已無法逆轉。
（前情提要：Bitwise 投資長：2026 年比特幣能否迎來長線牛市，關鍵要跨越三大考驗）
（背景補充：Circle 股價暴跌 20%、Coinbase 重挫！新版《清晰法案》擬封殺「穩定幣生息」，Tether 合規曙光施壓 USDC）
Bitwise 資訊長 Matt Hougan 在最新分析中拆解，美國參議院即將在 8 月 7 日進入夏季休會，被視為加密產業里程碑的《CLARITY 法案》若無法在本週投票，過關機率恐大幅下滑。但他強調，法案失敗不代表產業末日，反而可能迎來更友善的 SEC 監管，且加密金融化的趨勢已如「魔盒」般無法關上。
先說壞訊息，即便本週《CLARITY 法案》闖關失敗，這件事也不會就此塵埃落定。法案將淪為「殭屍法案」，不會被徹底廢止，但只能艱難地推進。
殭屍法案：拖到 9 月或 12 月夾帶過關
隨著八月截止日期臨近，已經市場傳出法案或許可以放到 9 月再表決。更有觀點提議推遲到 12 月，也就是國會復會召開跛腳鴨會議期間（注，跛腳鴨會議指美國 11 月國會大選結束之後、次年 1 月 3 日新一屆國會議員正式宣誓就職之前，即將卸任的舊一屆國會繼續開會議事的會期，就叫跛腳鴨會議）。美國國會經常將多項法案打包成年終綜合撥款法案（omnibus package），讓議員被迫對整包法案表決，其中夾雜他們支援和反對的條款。有人寄希望《CLARITY 法案》借這種方式闖關。在週三截止日期過後，預計會不斷出現相關報道，討論在今年秋冬把該法案 「夾帶透過」。
這件事的負面影響在於，法案帶來的不確定性，讓不少專業機構投資者保持觀望。他們不想投入資金布局加密資產，卻遭遇法案失利、市場隨之下跌。機構更傾向於等待局勢明朗之後再行動。
如果本週法案未能過關，最有利的情景是，Polymarket 上法案的透過機率進一步明顯走低，至少跌到百分之十幾。如果這種情況發生，市場可能會短暫波動，但會為秋季的反彈做好準備。
機構資金為何持續觀望？
更重要的是，加密產業本身不會受到致命打擊。
就算《CLARITY 法案》無法落實，產業也會找到自己的出路。上週，美國證券交易委員會（SEC）主席 Paul Atkins 在 CNBC 採訪中說得非常直白。他表示，SEC「已經做好準備，願意並且能夠出臺監管規則，以解決與 CLARITY 法案相同的問題」。
這裡存在利弊權衡。短期來看，由 Atkins 執掌的 SEC 出臺的監管規則，相比國會兩黨博弈誕生的法案，高機率會對加密產業和創新更加友好，甚至可能成為產業助推劑。但風險在於，未來新一屆政府可能任命立場不友好的 SEC 主席，將這些規則推翻。
SEC 接手監管：短期利多、長期風險
即便如此，我認為未來的 SEC 主席也很難逆轉加密產業前進的大勢。產業正全速賓士，金融業務正在向鏈上遷移。貝萊德盈利最高的 ETF 就是比特幣 ETF；納斯達克、摩根大通這類巨頭大力推進資產代幣化；Visa、萬事達卡、Stripe 與 Coinbase 合作推出穩定幣平台；Robinhood 已經推出自有區塊鏈，可對接 Uniswap、Morpho 等 DeFi 應用。
與此同時，加密企業正在接入美國聯邦銀行體系，美國貨幣監理署（OCC）已經向 Circle、Ripple、Paxos 以及越來越多的企業授予信託牌照。全球各個國家和地區，歐盟、日本乃至俄羅斯，都在爭相出臺利多加密產業的法律。
假設《CLARITY 法案》失敗，改為由 SEC 出臺監管規則，加密產業至少還有兩年半的發展視窗期 —— 直到新一屆政府有可能任命新任 SEC 主席。到那個時間點，無論哪位 SEC 主席，都無法再把已經放出的 「魔盒」 重新關上。
華爾街巨頭已全面押注鏈上金融
現實情況是，華盛頓在重大技術變革面前總是反應滯後，而最終造成的影響往往沒有人們預想的那麼嚴重。1994 年，眾議院以 423 票贊成、4 票反對的懸殊票數透過大規模電信改革法案，最終法案卻擱置在參議院，沒有迎來全院投票。聽上去是不是似曾相識？但網際網路並沒有原地等待。此後兩年，網景瀏覽器發布並完成上市，亞馬遜、eBay 相繼成立，網站數量呈指數級增長。國會最終跟上時代，1996 年電信法案以 91 比 5 的巨大優勢在參議院透過，這份法案也為後續數十年的產業增長奠定基礎。回頭來看，兩年的政策推遲，並沒有真正拖慢產業發展。
華盛頓的治理效率不盡如人意。明明可以出臺法案，既保護投資者，又激勵創新，卻遲遲無法落實，在我看來十分荒唐。但這件事並不能用來評判加密資產是否有資格成為全球金融基礎設施的組成部分。加密成為金融的一環，早已是既成事實。時至今日，加密產業已經積蓄足夠動能，無論未來幾天國會的結果如何，它都將在未來數十年重塑整個金融體系。

〈AI 眼鏡作弊在亞洲大流行！台灣分科測驗抓到第一個，明年起帶進考場就不計分〉這篇文章最早發佈於動區BlockTempo《動區動趨-最具影響力的區塊鏈新聞媒體》。
full_text:
一副 AI 智慧眼鏡在韓國大學修學能力測驗的模擬考上，用 18 分鐘拿下 96 分。台灣今年已經抓到兩起，7 月的 115 學年分科測驗首度出動金屬探測器，當場揪出物理科一名配戴 AI 眼鏡的考生並取消資格。大考中心已經拍板，116 學年起智慧眼鏡從其他穿戴裝置獨立列項，攜帶或配戴都算舞弊，該科不計分，情節重大取消全部成績。CNN 的調查指出，這波智慧作弊潮的震央就在亞洲。
（前情提要：兩個百萬追蹤的搭訕偷拍帳號遭 IG 封鎖，Meta 終於出手管智慧眼鏡）
（背景補充：AI 靠微表情識破德州撲克手牌，頂尖玩家狂酸：鏡頭拍不到真實心理戰）
監考老師過去要抓的是小抄、手機和寫在手臂上的字。現在要抓的東西戴在臉上，看起來就是普通眼鏡。
戴 AI 眼鏡作弊的過程完全不需要手動，用鏡框上的鏡頭掃描題目，影像送進大型語言模型運算，答案直接投影在鏡片內側。全程沒有低頭、沒有伸手、沒有任何監考人員看得出來的異常。在韓國最近的考場實測裡面，AI 眼鏡在大學能力測驗的模擬考上花 18 分鐘寫完，拿到 96 分。
台灣抓到兩起，金屬探測器第一次上場
台灣今年已經連續出現兩起作弊。
第一起在 6 月，一名重考台大醫學系與牙醫系的考生，在生物科考試中被抓到配戴 AI 智慧眼鏡，眼鏡能即時掃描題目並顯示答案，這是台灣首度確認的 AI 眼鏡作弊案例。
第二起就在 7 月的 115 學年分科測驗。第一天物理科，一名考生因為配戴 AI 眼鏡被抓，考試資格當場取消。抓到他的關鍵是大考中心首次部署的金屬探測器。
大考中心目前明文禁止攜帶智慧眼鏡、智慧手錶與智慧手環進入考場，並且建議在教室加裝訊號阻斷器來屏蔽連線。監考的手段從老師的眼睛，變成金屬探測器和電波屏蔽，算是與時俱進。
還有一個算是土法煉鋼但有效的破綻，這類眼鏡在連續運算時會發燙。考生摸眼鏡的頻率、鏡框的溫度，現在都成了監考人員被提醒要注意的細節。
18 分鐘考出 96 分，韓國大震撼
韓國的情況比台灣更早爆發，也更密集。韓國在 5 月出現首批已知案例，兩名考生分別在 5 月 10 日與 5 月 31 日的 TOEIC 考試中被抓到配戴 AI 智慧眼鏡，同月的電氣與消防安全技師證照考試也抓到三人。真正讓輿論炸開的是那次 18 分鐘 96 分的實測，AI 的表現直接勝過絕大多數把整個青春押在這場考試上的學生。
韓國教育部近期才向各地教育廳發出指示，要求把 AI 眼鏡列入考場違禁品清單。但大學端幾乎是空白，首爾大學、高麗大學、梨花女子大學、成均館大學等主要學校，到目前都還沒有針對智慧眼鏡作弊展開討論或訂出處理準則。
據 CNN 6 月的報導，這波作弊潮在南韓、台灣與中國都有確認案例，考試至上的亞洲是爆發潮震央。原因不難理解，亞洲人對於考試的態度，影響在社會上立足的起點，值得冒這個險。
明年起帶進考場就不計分
台灣的下一步 AI 防弊已經定案，而且比現在嚴格。
116 學年度起，智慧眼鏡會從智慧手錶、智慧手環這類穿戴裝置中獨立出來單獨列項，罰則同步加重。攜帶或配戴都構成舞弊，違反者該科不計分，情節重大者取消全部成績。大考中心的說法是對智慧眼鏡採零容忍。
值得注意的是「攜帶」兩個字。過去的規範多半處罰使用行為，現在只要東西在身上就成立，這代表主管機關已經放棄在考場裡即時判定「有沒有真的用」，因為根本判不出來。舉證太難，只好把界線往前推到考生入場的時候。
真正麻煩的問題還在後面。當作弊工具的外型跟一般眼鏡再也分不出來，考場能做的就只剩下全面禁止所有眼鏡，而這顯然不可能。到那一天，需要被重新設計的就不是防弊規則，是考試方式本身。

title: Apple漏洞獎金被「AI假報告」塞爆！真正白帽獵人送不進去
summary:
Apple 對漏洞獎金計畫設了上限限制，原因是 AI 生成的假漏洞報告淹沒了自家資安團隊。義大利資安公司 By […]

〈Apple漏洞獎金被「AI假報告」塞爆！真正白帽獵人送不進去〉這篇文章最早發佈於動區BlockTempo《動區動趨-最具影響力的區塊鏈新聞媒體》。
full_text:
Apple 對漏洞獎金計畫設了上限限制，原因是 AI 生成的假漏洞報告淹沒了自家資安團隊。義大利資安公司 Bynario 用 ChatGPT 在三週內於 macOS 找出 50 多個漏洞，其中一個是能完全接管系統的提權漏洞，卻因為配額限制送不進去。而 Apple 現在的解法，是再派一套 AI 去分類這些 AI 產出的報告。
（前情提要：白帽駭客揭露 Cosmos 暗藏 0-day 漏洞！節點重啟恐全面死鎖癱瘓，官方卻將通報當垃圾郵件）
（背景補充：OpenAI 傳再爆 AI 代理「逃脫沙盒」！內部調查揭更多失控證據，遭質疑是行銷噱頭）
漏洞獎金計畫的邏輯很簡單，你找到我的問題，我付你錢。這套運作二十年的機制，正在被一群不用自己動腦的獵人們拖垮。
據《金融時報》揭露，Apple 已經對資安研究員能同時開啟的新漏洞報告數量設上限，並在兩批提交之間加上 30 天冷卻期，內部研究員可以事先申請調高額度。
Apple 的說法是：「隨著整個產業 AI 生成的資安提交量成長，我們最近調整了研究員一次能開啟的新報告數量。」
意思就是，Apple 的工程師被 AI 幻覺出來的假漏洞投稿淹沒，真正有料的報告卡在垃圾裡找不到。
三週挖出 50 個漏洞送不進去
這件事的荒謬在一個具體案例上看得最清楚。
義大利資安新創 Bynario 用 ChatGPT 掃 macOS，三週找出 50 多個漏洞。這些不全是垃圾，其中一個是提權漏洞，利用它可以拿到 Mac 的無限制存取權，等於整台機器交出去。
問題是 Bynario 送不進去，他們的提交額度已經用完，Apple 事後表示已經和這家公司聯繫、正在檢視他們的提交。
這就是配額制的副作用。Apple 想擋的是用 AI 亂槍打鳥的業餘獵人，但同樣的門檻也擋住了用 AI 認真做事的人。
curl 早就被打垮過一次
Apple 不是第一個投降的，只是最有錢的那個。
curl 這個幾乎裝在全世界每一台連網裝置上的開源工具，維護者 Daniel Stenberg 在 2026 年 2 月 1 日直接關掉了 HackerOne 上的漏洞獎金計畫。原因一模一樣，AI 生成的漏洞報告又長又自信，而且經常整份是編出來的幻覺。
curl 的提交裡確認為真實漏洞的比例，多年來都在 15% 以上，2025 年掉到 5% 以下，到年底變成大約每 20 到 30 份才有 1 份是準確的。Stenberg 形容這已經不是資安審查，是恐怖攻擊通報，把他七人資安團隊的時間、注意力，以及「活下去的意志」全部抽乾。
curl 的獎金開到重大漏洞 1 萬美元、低危 500 美元，錢不多，但足以吸引一批人把 LLM 的輸出直接貼上來碰運氣。關掉獎金一個月後，curl 在 3 月又回到 HackerOne，報告品質有改善，但數量繼續往上爬。
Apple 的解法是再派一套 AI
最後蘋果的做法才是整件事真正的黑色幽默。
Apple 處理這些 AI 垃圾的方式，是部署自家的 AI 來做初步分類，人工驗證仍然保留。同時 Apple 因為參加了 Project Glasswing 的計畫，用 Claude Mythos 這類模型主動找自家產品的漏洞，強化對 AI 攻擊的防禦。
所以現在的畫面是這樣，一邊是用 AI 生成漏洞報告的人，另一邊是用 AI 過濾漏洞報告的 Apple，中間夾著一小群真的懂資安的人類，負責在兩台機器的交火中把真漏洞撿出來。
補一個細節，Stenberg 過去曾公開說 Mythos 是「公關噱頭」，而 Apple 現在正在用它守門，打臉真的很快。
*本文僅供參考，不構成投資建議。文中 Apple 政策調整細節來自《金融時報》報導與 Apple 對外說法，curl 相關數據取自維護者 Daniel Stenberg 公開發表的說明。*

title: 量子威脅下金融與比特幣如何升級？XREX 黃耀文：區塊鏈靠共識、法幣靠權力結構
summary:
全球風險研究所調查顯示，未來十年內出現可破解現行加密技術的量子電腦，機率為 28% 至 49%，15 年內升至 […]

〈量子威脅下金融與比特幣如何升級？XREX 黃耀文：區塊鏈靠共識、法幣靠權力結構〉這篇文章最早發佈於動區BlockTempo《動區動趨-最具影響力的區塊鏈新聞媒體》。
full_text:
全球風險研究所調查顯示，未來十年內出現可破解現行加密技術的量子電腦，機率為 28% 至 49%，15 年內升至 51% 至 70%。XREX 共同創辦人暨集團執行長黃耀文 Wayne 出席第 11 屆《WHATs NEXT》量子科技高峰會指出，量子技術對整體金融產業的威脅遠大於對加密貨幣的影響，而金融機構可依主管機關時程遷移，比特幣的升級卻必須先凝聚社群共識。
（前情提要：貝萊德、Strategy 等 9 大巨頭聯手成立「比特幣安全聯盟」！挹注 1,500 萬美元防禦量子威脅）
（背景補充：G7 央行首發報告：量子電腦 10 年內破解現代密碼！警告「先收割後解密」系統性危機）
本文為新聞稿，由 XREX 提供。
重點摘要
- GRI 調查：十年內出現可破解現行加密的量子電腦機率 28% 至 49%，15 年內升至 51% 至 70%
- 黃耀文：量子技術對整體金融產業的威脅，遠大於對區塊鏈加密貨幣的影響
- 金管會 2026 年 6 月已發布《金融業後量子密碼遷移參考指引》
量子電腦（quantum computer）持續進步，金融產業也開始正視相關風險。全球風險研究所（Global Risk Institute, GRI）最新調查顯示，未來十年內出現可破解現行加密技術的量子電腦，機率為 28% 至 49%；15 年內則升至 51% 至 70%。
身為資安專家的 XREX 共同創辦人暨集團執行長黃耀文 Wayne 出席第 11 屆《WHATs NEXT》量子科技高峰會指出，若現行加密技術與電子簽章機制遭破解，銀行帳戶、證券交易、訊息及歷史交易資料都可能受影響，不僅是區塊鏈上的比特幣（Bitcoin, BTC）面臨同樣威脅。
第 11 屆《WHATs NEXT》量子科技高峰會「信任講堂」與會者合影 | 圖片來源：XREX 集團
量子威脅不再只是科幻：金融業加密遷移可能耗時多年
現階段量子電腦，尚無法破解銀行系統採用的主流加密技術，但更換加密技術並不是替手機更新軟體。銀行須盤點帳戶驗證、交易簽章、資料傳輸，以及與外部供應商的介接系統，再分批測試與切換，可能耗時多年。在銀行評估與執行升級的過程中，量子電腦的發展也同步加速，攻擊者也可能先攔截今日的加密資料，待量子電腦成熟後再破解，稱為「先攔截、日後解密」（Harvest Now, Decrypt Later, HNDL），對既有金融體系的考驗與壓力日增。
量子攻擊不再只是科幻情節。台灣金管會已於 2026 年 6 月發布《金融業後量子密碼遷移參考指引》，要求金融機構因應「先攔截、日後解密」及「現在信任、稍後偽造」兩類威脅。
美國國家標準暨技術研究院（National Institute of Standards and Technology, NIST）已發布後量子密碼學（Post-Quantum Cryptography, PQC）標準。這套技術可在現有電腦上運作，目的在抵抗未來量子電腦的破解能力。
當金融與區塊鏈都必須換鎖，真正的挑戰不是技術，而是如何讓整套系統同步升級。
黃耀文：量子技術對金融業的威脅大於加密貨幣
身為國際著名資安專家的黃耀文認為，無論是量體還是普及性而言，量子技術對整體金融產業的威脅，遠大於對區塊鏈加密貨幣的影響。
現行金融與網路系統的加密技術，如同數位世界的鎖與印章，「鎖」保護資料不被窺視，「印章」確認指令來源與內容完整性。
若量子電腦能開啟這些鎖、仿造印章，失效的就不只是登入密碼。銀行帳戶、證券交易、電子簽章、訊息及歷史交易資料，都可能失去保護，動搖整套金融系統的信任基礎。
黃耀文以 2000 年的「千禧蟲危機」（Year 2000 problem, Y2K）為例，當時企業與政府提前多年檢查、修正舊系統，才讓大部分系統平穩跨過年份切換。後量子遷移同樣必須及早準備，不能等危機發生才行動。
XREX 共同創辦人暨集團執行長黃耀文 Wayne 出席第 11 屆《WHATs NEXT》量子科技高峰會時指出，量子技術對整體金融產業的威脅，遠大於對區塊鏈加密貨幣的影響，必須及早準備，不能等危機發生才行動。 | 圖片來源：XREX 集團
金融機構依監管時程遷移，比特幣升級須凝聚社群共識
貨幣的信任從何而來？法定貨幣（fiat currency）由國家發行與承認，價值不只來自紙鈔或支付技術，也建立在政府、中央銀行、法律及金融制度構成的「權力結構」上。
黃耀文舉例，舊台幣曾被新台幣取代；美元的國際地位，也與戰後佈列敦森林體系（Bretton Woods system）及美國國力相連。
比特幣的邏輯不同，沒有政府或公司直接下令，也沒有單一機構能宣布新版規則生效。它依靠分散各地的參與者，以同一套規則確認交易、記錄帳本及維護網路，只要多數重要參與者持續接受這套規則，系統就能運作。
區塊鏈作為共識科技，核心的存續價值在於信任，甚至有點趨近於宗教信仰。黃耀文以佛教為例，儘管沒有單一組織統一管理，各地傳統仍可共存於同一體系。區塊鏈也能在沒有中央機構的情況下，透過共同規則長期運作。
因此，法定貨幣與區塊鏈的差異，不只在於有沒有發行人，更在於信任來源，前者依靠國家與制度，後者則依靠共同規則及參與者對規則的持續接受。
同樣是升級：金融機構依主管機關時程，比特幣要先說服社群
信任來源不同，也形成不同的升級路徑。受監管金融機構可依主管機關時程盤點系統、測試新技術並逐步切換；比特幣沒有主管機關要求全球同步更新，必須先讓礦工、節點、開發者、交易所及使用者接受新規則。
比特幣社群過去已透過軟分叉（soft fork），在盡量相容舊版本的前提下更新規則。黃耀文認為，未來若要加入抵抗量子攻擊的能力，關鍵仍是社群能否形成足夠共識。
穩定幣位於兩種制度的交界，它在區塊鏈上流通，價格通常對應美元等法定貨幣，因此同時使用區塊鏈技術並接受金融監管。黃耀文認為，穩定幣業者可能較早接到升級要求，率先匯入新加密技術，並為更去中心化的生態繫累積實務經驗。
金管會資訊服務處處長林裕泰在論壇中指出，金管會已啟動金融業後量子密碼遷移規劃，未來將擴大與金融機構、資通訊供應商及跨產業合作，建立量子時代的資安韌性。對金融與區塊鏈產業而言，真正的問題不只是量子威脅何時到來，而是能否在信任機制遭突破前，先完成規則、系統與產業協作升級。
關於 XREX 集團
創立於 2018 年，XREX 集團是一家擁有區塊鏈技術的國際金融機構，與銀行、政府及使用者密切合作，共同改寫金融定義。
XREX 集團台灣子公司鏈科股份有限公司營運 XREX 交易所，於 2022 年 3 月，完成與台灣金融監督管理委員會（金管會）的洗錢防制法令遵循宣告，並於 2025 年 9 月 22 日完成金管會的洗錢防制登記，為完成的八家合規虛擬資產服務商之一；新加坡子公司於 2024 年 5 月取得新加坡金融管理局（MAS）大型支付機構（MPI）執照。
XREX 集團將普惠金融視為社會責任，持續運用區塊鏈技術推進金融參與權、金融使用權與金融教育權，並推出 XREX Academy 區塊鏈與虛擬資產系統化教育課程。
常見問題
什麼是「先攔截、日後解密」（HNDL）？
攻擊者先攔截並儲存今天的加密資料，等未來量子電腦成熟後再回頭破解。這代表即使現在的加密還沒被攻破，今天傳輸的敏感資料仍可能在數年後失去保護。
比特幣要抵抗量子攻擊，為什麼比銀行難？
受監管金融機構可依主管機關時程盤點系統、逐步切換，比特幣沒有主管機關能要求全球同步更新，必須先讓礦工、節點、開發者、交易所與使用者對新規則形成足夠共識。

title: 商業時報：三箭清算人告上 Zhu Su 老婆！追討 4,000 萬鎂杜拜房產
summary:
三箭資本（3AC）清算人向 Zhu Su 之妻陶雅瓊博士（音譯）提起訴訟，追討約 4,000 萬美元（約 1. […]

〈商業時報：三箭清算人告上 Zhu Su 老婆！追討 4,000 萬鎂杜拜房產〉這篇文章最早發佈於動區BlockTempo《動區動趨-最具影響力的區塊鏈新聞媒體》。
full_text:
三箭資本（3AC）清算人向 Zhu Su 之妻陶雅瓊博士（音譯）提起訴訟，追討約 4,000 萬美元（約 1.46 億迪拉姆）的杜拜房產出售所得。清算人指控，Zhu Su 在 2022 年 6 月三箭進入清算程序前三週，動用從公司挪用的 5,000 萬美元加密貨幣，以 1.1 億迪拉姆（約 3,000 萬美元）買下一處杜拜房產，並在 2023 年 10 月於新加坡服刑期間把房產過戶到妻子名下，該房產隔年 1 月出售。陶雅瓊否認指控，稱自己對資金來源不知情，並以善意受贈為由聲請法院駁回訴訟。三箭目前對債權人負債逾 30 億美元。
（前情提要：三箭資本獲賠 15.3 億鎂！Zhu Su：想問 SBF 有什麼「項目新點子」、對 Solana 和 Hyperliquid 怎麼看）
（背景補充：獨家專訪》三箭資本 Zhu Su 出獄後心境：FTX 倒閉秘辛、減半後行情分析、再質押、USDe 週期在哪？）
三箭資本的清算人把追討對象換成了 Zhu Su 的妻子。據《商業時報》報導，清算人已對陶雅瓊博士提起訴訟，要追回一處杜拜房產的出售所得，金額約 4,000 萬美元，換算約 1.46 億迪拉姆。
清算人的指控圍繞一條時間線展開。2022 年 6 月，也就是三箭正式進入清算程序前三週，Zhu Su 動用從公司挪走的 5,000 萬美元加密貨幣，以 1.1 億迪拉姆、當時約 3,000 萬美元的價格買下這處杜拜房產。2023 年 10 月，他把房產過戶到妻子名下。2024 年 1 月，房產被賣掉。
清算人主張，這次過戶的目的是把資產挪到清算人與債權人追索不到的地方，而且 Zhu Su 並沒有依規定向清算人揭露這處房產的存在。
有一個數字這則報導沒有交代。清算人指控被挪用的加密貨幣是 5,000 萬美元，房產買價卻是 3,000 萬美元，中間那 2,000 萬美元的去向並未說明。
陶雅瓊：我不知道錢從哪來
陶雅瓊否認清算人的指控。她的答辯有兩個支點，一是她對這筆資金的來源不知情，二是她屬於善意受贈，因此聲請法院直接駁回這起訴訟。
在脫產類的追討案裡，這是相當標準的抗辯路線。清算人要贏，通常必須證明受讓的一方知情或應該知情，而不只是證明錢的來源有問題。案子最後會不會走到實體審理，第一關就卡在她這個駁回聲請上。
另外一點，陶雅瓊並不是第一次出現在三箭的資產清單上。Zhu Su 在 2019 至 2021 年間於新加坡買下三棟優質洋房，登記在他自己與妻子名下，總價約 8,355 萬新幣。2024 年 11 月，她把其中位於 Dalvey Road 的一棟以 5,100 萬新幣、約 3,800 萬美元賣出，當時全球資產凍結令已經生效。清算人這幾年追的，很大一部分就是這些登記在配偶名下的資產。
四年債權訴訟
這起訴訟要放進清算人已經打了四年的戰線裡看才有意義。
2023 年 12 月，新加坡法院應清算人 Teneo 之請，對 Zhu Su、Kyle Davies 以及 Davies 之妻 Kelly Chen 下達全球資產凍結令，金額 11.4 億美元。清算人目前向兩位共同創辦人追討的金額約 13 億美元，而三箭對債權人的負債超過 30 億美元。Teneo 先前估算的債權人回收率約 46%，這個數字能不能兌現，取決於這類追討案的成敗。
創辦人這邊也不是沒有還手。2025 年 6 月，Zhu Su 與 Kyle Davies 在新加坡上訴庭拿到一半的勝利，法院撤銷了清算人取得的訊問令，但維持了要求他們揭露三箭相關資訊的命令。攻防仍在來回。
三箭倒下已經四年，這場清算最有效率的階段早就過去，剩下的都是硬骨頭。當追討對象從創辦人本人變成配偶、從新加坡的洋房變成杜拜的房產出售所得，說明容易拿的部分已經拿完了。
*本文僅供參考，不構成投資建議。文中所述均為清算人在訴訟中提出的指控，尚未經法院認定，陶雅瓊已否認相關指控並聲請駁回訴訟。案件進展應以法院正式裁定為準。*

title: Predict.fun 開放上證指數漲跌預測！當前機率停在 50 比 50
summary:
預測市場平台 Predict.fun 上線「上證指數 2026 年 8 月 6 日會漲還是跌」的市場，截至發稿 […]

〈Predict.fun 開放上證指數漲跌預測！當前機率停在 50 比 50〉這篇文章最早發佈於動區BlockTempo《動區動趨-最具影響力的區塊鏈新聞媒體》。
full_text:
預測市場平台 Predict.fun 上線「上證指數 2026 年 8 月 6 日會漲還是跌」的市場，截至發稿，收漲機率停在 50%，漲跌雙方預期幾乎完全均衡。這是預測市場少見地把題目押在中國 A 股的單日走向上，而上證指數 8 月 5 日才剛收漲 1.47% 至 3,878.43 點。Predict.fun 是 BNB Chain 上的預測市場，2025 年 12 月上線，累積交易量已超過 18 億美元，7 月才引進 Susquehanna Crypto 當大額交易的流動性提供者。
（前情提要：Polymarket 尋求 10 億美元新融資！估值上看 200 億美元，年化營收翻三倍突破 12 億鎂）
（背景補充：長鑫科技上市飆漲 471% 成 A 股市值王！野村喊 116 元目標、鯨魚 1,726 萬美元空單對賭）
預測市場平台 Predict.fun 掛出一個新題目，賭的是上證指數（SSE Composite Index）2026 年 8 月 6 日收盤會漲還是跌。截至發稿，市場給收漲的機率是 50%，漲跌兩邊的預期站在同一條線上。
Predict.fun 不是 Polymarket 或 Kalshi 那種美式平台。它 2025 年 12 月上線，主場在 BNB Chain，特色是抵押品放在平台上會繼續生息，用戶不必為了下注犧牲資金效率。上線後成長很快，累積交易量已超過 18 億美元，近 30 日一度做到 5.34 億美元，期間還吃下 BNB Chain 上的同業 Probable，並拿到 CZ 的公開背書。7 月 7 日平台推出大額 block trading，找來傳統造市巨頭 Susquehanna 的加密部門 Susquehanna Crypto 供應流動性。
把題目押在上證指數，多少能看出這個平台的用戶輪廓。Polymarket 和 Kalshi 的主戰場是美國政治、聯準會與體育賽事，一個 BNB Chain 系、由 CZ 加持的平台把 A 股搬上檯面，賭的是華語圈用戶對這個指數的熟悉度。
市場剛開始
剛上線的每日型市場通常只有零星幾筆交易。在這種狀態下，50% 比較可能是初始定價還沒被真金白銀推動，而不是一群交易者互相廝殺後達成的共識。判斷一個預測市場的機率有沒有意義，要先看背後有多少錢，這件事在小眾題目上尤其重要。
指數本身的位置倒是可以參考，上證指數 8 月 5 日收在 3,878.43 點，當天漲 1.47%，近五個交易日累計上漲 1.30%，但把時間拉長到一個月，指數仍下跌約 4.03%，7 月一度站上的 4,000 點大關已經失守。剛收了一根 1.47% 的紅 K，隔天的方向確實不好猜，50 比 50 至少誠實。
真正值得追蹤的不是明天的結果，而是這類每日型的股指市場能不能養出流動性。預測市場過去兩年靠選舉、體育和聯準會決策做大，這些題目有一個共同點，就是資訊本身會流動、參與者有觀點差異。單日指數漲跌沒有這個條件，如果 Predict.fun 的 A 股題目最後只停在 50% 沒人下注，那就是市場給出的另一種答案。
*本文僅供參考，不構成投資建議。文中 Predict.fun 市場機率為發稿時數據，預測市場報價隨時變動，且流動性偏低的市場其機率不宜視為市場共識。上證指數數據取自公開行情。*

title: WBTC 大遷徙！73 億美元轉投 Chainlink，LayerZero 失血近 150 億
summary:
BitGo 宣布將 73 億美元 WBTC 的跨鏈服務從 LayerZero 遷往 Chainlink CCI […]

〈WBTC 大遷徙！73 億美元轉投 Chainlink，LayerZero 失血近 150 億〉這篇文章最早發佈於動區BlockTempo《動區動趨-最具影響力的區塊鏈新聞媒體》。
full_text:
BitGo 宣布將 73 億美元 WBTC 的跨鏈服務從 LayerZero 遷往 Chainlink CCIP，加上 Mantle、Kraken 等專案，累計遷移資金逼近 150 億美元；導火線是 Kelp 跨鏈橋被盜 2.92 億美元，LayerZero 信任正在崩解。
（前情提要：Vanta 將於 7 月 30 日開啟總獎池 10 萬 USDC 的交易賽）
（背景補充：LayerZero 收購 Stargate 遭「攪局」：Wormhole 高調抬價請求暫停投票）
WBTC 的跨鏈版圖正在重新洗牌。CoinDesk 報導指出，BitGo 決定以 Chainlink CCIP 取代 LayerZero 作為 73 億美元 WBTC 的唯一跨鏈服務商，使 LayerZero 流失資金累計達 146 億美元。這不是單一商業決策，而是 Kelp 2.92 億美元被盜案後，DeFi 基礎設施信任層的連鎖崩塌。
73 億美元 WBTC 倒戈，LayerZero 失血破 146 億
區塊鏈基礎設施商 BitGo 決定改以 Chainlink 取代 LayerZero，獨家承接 73 億美元 WBTC 的跨鏈轉移。合計已宣布跳槽至 Chainlink 的資金量逼近 150 億美元。
整波遷移潮的導火線是今年稍早 Kelp DAO 基於 LayerZero 的跨鏈橋遭 2.92 億美元攻擊，事件讓 LayerZero 的橋接設定遭到嚴格檢視。此後 Mantle、Kelp、Lombard、Solv Protocol、Virtuals、Re 和 Kraken 等專案陸續宣布轉向 Chainlink 的 CCIP。
WBTC 是比特幣的代幣化版本，目的是錨定比特幣價值。與原生比特幣不同，它可以在其他區塊鏈的去中心化金融應用中用於交易、借貸和抵押。
2.92 億美元被盜案：一把火燒掉跨鏈信任
CoinMarketCap 資料顯示，WBTC 目前市值約 74 億美元。加上早前宣布遷移的 72.4 億美元，遷至 CCIP 的跨鏈基礎設施資金總額約 146 億美元。
BitGo 宣布將以 Chainlink 跨鏈代幣標準統一 WBTC 部署，並在未來發行的資產中預設使用 CCIP。
該架構讓 BitGo 保有代幣合約的控制權，並設定速率限制和其他管理跨鏈轉賬的控制措施。
Chainlink CCIP 收編 BitGo：合約控制權是關鍵
BitGo 於 2024 年選擇 LayerZero 擴充套件 WBTC 跨鏈能力，最初用於 Avalanche 和 BNB Chain 的部署。其配置要求 BitGo 自有驗證器以及 LayerZero 或 Polyhedra 批准每筆跨鏈轉賬。
Chainlink 目錄已列出以太坊和 Ronin 上支援 CCIP 的 WBTC 資金池。官方公告並未揭露全面遷移的完成時間。

title: SpaceX 盤前下跌 8%，關鍵在單季資本支出
summary:
SpaceX 8 月 4 日盤後交出上市以來首份財報，每股虧損 0.09 美元、不到市場預期 0.26 美元的 […]

〈SpaceX 盤前下跌 8%，關鍵在單季資本支出〉這篇文章最早發佈於動區BlockTempo《動區動趨-最具影響力的區塊鏈新聞媒體》。
full_text:
SpaceX 8 月 4 日盤後交出上市以來首份財報，每股虧損 0.09 美元、不到市場預期 0.26 美元的一半，營收 78.1 億美元年增 92% 也優於預期，股價卻在盤後一度重挫 8%。關鍵在單季資本支出衝上 183.7 億美元，是去年同期六倍，而公司這次沒有給出任何前瞻指引。
（前情提要：SpaceX 財報：AI 營收打贏太空本業，但燒錢太快盤後股價重摔 8%）
（背景補充：SpaceX 首輪解鎖 9.12 億股明日到期，分階段拉長賣壓）
重點摘要
- SpaceX 上市後首份財報營收 78.1 億美元、年增 92%，優於預期的 69.3 億
- 單季資本支出 183.7 億美元，是去年同期的六倍，其中 158.3 億花在 AI
- 股價 8 月 4 日盤後一度跌 8%，8 月 5 日盤前報 112.45 美元、跌 1.81%
太空探索科技公司（SpaceX）在 8 月 4 日美股盤後公布 6 月 12 日掛牌以來的首份財報，營收與每股虧損雙雙優於市場預期，股價卻在盤後一度重挫 8%。到 8 月 5 日盤前，SPCX 報 112.45 美元、跌 1.81%，前一個交易日收在 114.53 美元。
財報數字其實是贏的
第二季營收 78.1 億美元，年增 92%，高於市場預期的 69.3 億美元。每股虧損 0.09 美元，也比預期的虧損 0.26 美元收窄。調整後 EBITDA 為 35.4 億美元，年增 191%。
分項來看，Starlink 訂戶突破 1,200 萬、年增一倍；2 月併入的 xAI 貢獻營收 25.6 億美元、年增 247%；企業與政府銷售 18.1 億美元，同樣翻倍以上。
市場真正在看的是資本支出
單季資本支出衝到 183.7 億美元，是去年同期 28.3 億美元的六倍以上，也遠超分析師預估的約 130 億美元。其中 158.3 億美元花在 AI 部門，也就是 2 月併進來的 xAI 相關算力建設。
財務長 Bret Johnsen 把利潤率擴張歸功於新的 AI 運算協議，但公司這次沒有提供任何前瞻指引，管理層在法說會上還表示支出會繼續增加。
常見問題
SpaceX 財報明明超預期，股價為什麼還跌？
市場關注的是單季 183.7 億美元的資本支出，比分析師預估的約 130 億高出四成，其中 158.3 億投入 AI 基建，而同期 xAI 營收只有 25.6 億美元，投入與產出落差明顯。
SpaceX 什麼時候上市的？股票代號是什麼？
SpaceX 於 2026 年 6 月 12 日在 Nasdaq 掛牌，代號 SPCX，承銷價 135 美元，首日收在 160.95 美元。這份 8 月 4 日公布的第二季財報是它上市後的第一份。

title: Hashdex 現貨比特幣 ETF 收攤！只剩 225 枚 BTC，錢都去追 AI 了
summary:
巴西加密資產管理商 Hashdex 8 月 3 日向美國 SEC 遞件宣布，關閉並清算旗下美國現貨比特幣 ET […]

〈Hashdex 現貨比特幣 ETF 收攤！只剩 225 枚 BTC，錢都去追 AI 了〉這篇文章最早發佈於動區BlockTempo《動區動趨-最具影響力的區塊鏈新聞媒體》。
full_text:
巴西加密資產管理商 Hashdex 8 月 3 日向美國 SEC 遞件宣布，關閉並清算旗下美國現貨比特幣 ETF（NYSE Arca: DEFI），8 月 17 日收盤後停止交易並下市，8 月 28 日前後把賣掉比特幣的現金分給股東。這檔基金截至 7 月 30 日規模只剩 1,470 萬美元、手上 225 枚比特幣，成為 2024 年 1 月首批現貨比特幣 ETF 上路以來，第一檔走到清算的美國現貨比特幣基金。同期間貝萊德 IBIT 的規模是 470.8 億美元，兩者差了 3,200 倍。
（前情提要：川普 Truth Social 撤回比特幣 ETF 申請，分析師：市場已是紅海競爭難有肉吃）
（背景補充：比特幣交易所流入低於年均 24%！賣壓沒來，買盤也乾了）
巴西加密資產管理商 Hashdex 8 月 3 日在 SEC 申報文件中宣布，關閉並清算旗下的 Hashdex Bitcoin ETF（NYSE Arca: DEFI）。這檔基金是 Hashdex Commodities Trust 底下唯一的一檔，截至 7 月 30 日，規模約 1,470 萬美元。
時間表已經寫死。股東可以在 8 月 17 日收盤前於 NYSE Arca 賣掉手上的股份，同一天之後基金停止接受授權參與者（AP，負責 ETF 申購贖回的造市機構）的申購單，接著下市。撐到最後一刻還持有的股東，預計在 8 月 28 日前後領到現金。
Hashdex 在公告裡列出原因，包括資金規模、交易流動性、營運成本、投資人興趣，以及這檔基金在自家指數型產品線裡的定位。公司同時強調，在美國市場仍管理超過 2 億美元的其他產品。
比較少人注意的是官方公告最後那句提醒。分配金額等於清算日的淨值，會反映關閉成本、交易成本，以及基金在賣出比特幣期間的價格變動，Hashdex 直接寫明「這些變動可能很大」。意思是投資人拿回多少錢，取決於這 225 枚比特幣賣掉那幾天的行情，沒有人能保證。
225 枚比特幣撐不起一檔 ETF
DEFI 的最終持倉是 225 枚比特幣，淨值約 1,425 萬美元，在外流通 20 萬股。這個數字放進美國現貨比特幣 ETF 的排行榜裡，幾乎看不見。
貝萊德 IBIT 的規模是 470.8 億美元，整個美國現貨比特幣 ETF 市場約 776 億美元。倒數第二小的 WisdomTree BTCW 有 1.424 億美元，是 DEFI 的將近 10 倍。DEFI 不只是最小的，而且跟「第二小」之間還隔了不小量級。
規模上不去，成本卻是固定的，掛牌 NYSE Arca 的行政、託管、審計、法遵開銷不會因為基金小就跟著縮水，這也是業界常說募資過不了 1 億美元門檻的加密產品很難養活自己的原因。DEFI 的內扣費用率是 0.90%，換算成年收入約 13 萬美元，這個數字連請一組專職團隊都不太夠。
更關鍵的是，DEFI 從頭到尾就沒做起來。這檔基金有紀錄的歷史最高規模出現在 2025 年 5 月 9 日，約 1,754 萬美元。它不是從高處摔下來，是一路走在同一條水平線上，直到公司決定不玩了。

title: USDT 總市值 60 日大減 40 億鎂逼近歷史極值，比特幣面臨流動性不足問題
summary:
比特幣現報 64,086 美元，24 小時上漲 0.70%。CryptoQuant 研究主管 Julio Mo […]

〈USDT 總市值 60 日大減 40 億鎂逼近歷史極值，比特幣面臨流動性不足問題〉這篇文章最早發佈於動區BlockTempo《動區動趨-最具影響力的區塊鏈新聞媒體》。
full_text:
比特幣現報 64,086 美元，24 小時上漲 0.70%。CryptoQuant 研究主管 Julio Moreno 指出，USDT 市值的 60 日已減少 40 億美元，逼近歷史最強的下降水平，且過去 11 天供應又少了約 8.7 億美元。市場最直接的流動性來源正在退潮，這解釋了近期反彈無力。
（前情提要：穩定幣市值創四年來最大跌幅，但交易量寫歷史新高）
（背景補充：比特幣交易所流入低於年均 24%！賣壓沒來，買盤也乾了）
重點摘要
- USDT 市值 60 日變化降至約減少 40 億美元，逼近歷史最負水平
- 比特幣報 64,086 美元，七天區間僅 1,045 美元，60 日仍有 5.12% 漲幅
- 代幣化美債規模逼近 170 億美元，GENIUS 法案禁付息把閒錢逼出穩定幣
比特幣在 8 月 5 日報 64,086 美元，24 小時上漲 0.70%，過去七天加密市場的盤整區間只在 2 千美元上下，背後支撐穩定幣的水位正在往下掉。
CryptoQuant 研究主管 Julio Moreno 指出，USDT 市值 60 日已大約減少 40 億美元，逼近歷史上最負的水平。更關鍵的是收縮還在加速，過去 11 天 USDT 供應量又少了約 8.7 億美元，代表這不是先前贖回潮的滯後效應，而是還在進行式，USDT 目前市值約 1,831 億美元。
燃料正在減少
新發行的 USDT 通常直接進入交易所，那就是交易員買幣的乾火藥（dry powder），這個術語是點燃上漲的燃料。如果單看穩定幣是驅動牛市的需求，那這個成長從去年 10 月中就停滯了。
上一次這個指標跌到這種程度是 2022 年熊市末段，當時比特幣在 16,000 美元附近觸底，市場處在恐慌與被迫平倉的迴圈裡。現在比特幣在 64,086 美元，距離 126,080 美元的歷史高點還有 49.17% 的差距，位置完全不同，流動性讀數卻回到同一個區間。
不過 2022 年沒有的變數，今年有一個。美國《GENIUS 法案》禁止穩定幣發行商向持有人支付收益，閒置的美元因此換了停車位，流向代幣化美債基金。這塊規模已經逼近 170 億美元，2 月時的高點還只有約 110 億。摩根士丹利在 8 月 3 日把 Circle 目標價砍到 38 美元，理由正是代幣化基金在侵蝕 USDC 的資金基礎。
換句話說，這輪穩定幣總量從 5 月中的 3,221 億美元高點掉到 8 月初約 3,075 億美元，6 月單月就蒸發 114 億，裡面有部分是避險轉移，也有一部分是監管把穩定幣直接收益關掉之後的結構性變化。
常見問題
USDT 供應減少為什麼會影響比特幣價格？
新發行的 USDT 多半流入交易所，是交易員買幣的資金來源。供應收縮代表可用流動性減少，買盤缺乏子彈，反彈容易在初期動能耗盡後回落。但 Moreno 本人強調，相關性不等於因果關係。
這次穩定幣收縮和 2022 年熊市底部一樣嗎？
讀數接近但成因不同。2022 年是被迫平倉與恐慌贖回，當時比特幣在 16,000 美元附近。這次多了《GENIUS 法案》禁止付息的結構性因素，閒置資金轉進規模近 170 億美元的代幣化美債基金。

title: 憂量子電腦破解比特幣！「華爾街狂人」宣告清倉賣幣、幣圈社群嗨翻天
summary:
《CNBC》財經名嘴、素有「 華爾街狂人 」之稱的 Jim Cramer 又一次宣告要出清比特幣了。這次的理由，是他擔憂「量子電腦」未來可能破解比特幣加密技術、威脅資產安全，而且他這次似乎是鐵了心要徹底退出幣圈。

〈憂量子電腦破解比特幣！「華爾街狂人」宣告清倉賣幣、幣圈社群嗨翻天〉這篇文章最早發佈於《區塊客》。
full_text:
《CNBC》財經名嘴、素有「華爾街狂人」之稱的 Jim Cramer 又一次宣告要出清比特幣了。這次的理由，是他擔憂「量子電腦」未來可能破解比特幣加密技術、威脅資產安全，而且他這次似乎是鐵了心要徹底退出幣圈。
不過，Jim Cramer 的退場宣言反而引來加密貨幣社群一片歡呼，不少投資人認為，這可能再次成為所謂的「Cramer 反指標」訊號。
Jim Cramer 上周專訪 IBM 執行長 Arvind Krishna 時主動詢問：未來量子電腦是否有能力破解比特幣錢包，甚至竊取持有者資產？對此，Arvind Krishna 回應稱：
我認為你大概還有 3 到 4 年的緩衝期，到了那時候，我會強烈建議你保持高度警覺。
「華爾街狂人」高喊清倉
然而，Jim Cramer 根本等不了 3 、 4 年。他在節目後提到：
我意識到自己正在坐以待斃。以太幣的處境可能甚至更糟。 Arvind Krishna 是量子領域的絕對權威，他懂量子科技，也懂比特幣。所以我決定要賣掉我的比特幣。
JIm Cramer 進一步補充說：「3 、 4 年？你知道 3 、 4 年有多快嗎？幾乎就是明天。」
這段訪談影片迅速在社群平台 X 上瘋傳，吸引近 10 萬次觀看。網友紛紛在底下狂歡留言：「比特幣準備起飛啦！」，甚至有人搞笑吐槽：「我還以為他早就賣光了。」
原因在於，華爾街多年來流傳著知名的「Cramer 反指標」，不少投資人認為，只要與 Jim Cramer 的投資建議反著做，勝率通常高得驚人。
2022 年 12 月，比特幣跌至約 16,796 美元時，Jim Cramer 就宣布已經賣光所有加密貨幣，甚至表示「一百萬年都不會再碰」；然而此後 3 年間，比特幣最高漲幅超過 400% 。到了 2024 年 1 月，他又改口稱比特幣是 「科技奇蹟」且「會長久存在」。
量子威脅是真議題嗎？
值得一提的是，Jim Cramer 最新宣布賣出比特幣當天，比特幣價格反而上漲約 1.6% 。不過，由於 Jim Cramer 從未公開自己的錢包地址，目前外界無法確認他究竟持有多少比特幣，甚至無法證實他是否真的持有比特幣。
雖然市場對 Cramer 的言論多半抱持戲謔態度，但量子電腦帶來的資安風險並非空穴來風。
7 月 30 日，IBM 與芝加哥大學研究團隊宣布，在 70 個邏輯量子位元（Logical Qubits）與新型錯誤校正技術下，成功完成一項傳統電腦幾乎無法驗證的運算，同時首次證明運算結果正確，成為量子運算發展的重要里程碑。
不過，研究人員指出，完成量子優勢與破解比特幣採用的橢圓曲線密碼學（Elliptic Curve Cryptography，ECC）仍屬兩個完全不同層級的技術挑戰，目前距離真正破解加密演算法仍相當遙遠。
專家這樣說
換言之，Jim Cramer 關注的議題本身並非毫無根據，但市場對於量子電腦真正威脅比特幣的時間點，仍存在相當大的分歧。
美國最大加密交易所 Coinbase 的就估計，由於「公鑰暴露」與「地址重複使用」等資安漏洞，最終可能會有約 700 萬枚比特幣面臨遭竊風險。
方舟投資（Ark Invest）則認為，量子威脅確實存在，但絕非迫在眉睫。事實上，抗量子密碼技術已逐漸成熟，而比特幣開發社群多年來也持續討論未來如何將相關標準導入比特幣網路，以降低潛在風險。

title: 預測市場 Polymarket 尋求新一輪融資，估值上看 200 億美元
summary:
預測市場正迎來史無前例的資金狂潮。《彭博社》周二引述知情人士報導，預測市場平台 Polymarket 正尋求新一輪融資，目標估值上看 200 億美元，展現出稱霸預測市場領域的強烈企圖心。

〈預測市場 Polymarket 尋求新一輪融資，估值上看 200 億美元〉這篇文章最早發佈於《區塊客》。
full_text:
預測市場正迎來史無前例的資金狂潮。《彭博社》周二引述知情人士報導，預測市場平台 Polymarket 正尋求新一輪融資，目標估值上看 200 億美元，展現出稱霸預測市場領域的強烈企圖心。
傳統金融巨頭進場，年化營收衝破 10 億美元
知情人士透露，Polymarket 今年 4 月才剛以 150 億美元估值完成一輪融資，其中更獲得紐約證交所（NYSE）母公司 —— 洲際交易所集團（ICE）投資 6 億美元，而傳統金融巨頭的加持，也讓 Polymarket 的市場地位更顯穩固。
亮眼的估值背後，有著強大的營收作支撐。 Polymarket 今年 6 月曾向《CNBC》透露，公司年化營收已突破 10 億美元大關，儘管平台交易量曾在 4 、 5 月經歷短暫低迷，但隨後在世足賽（World Cup）期間創下歷史新高的交易熱潮，成功逆轉頹勢。
至於外界該如何定義 Polymarket？創辦人、執行長 Shayne Coplan 始終強調，Polymarket 應該被視為「資訊平台」，而非博弈網站。他今年 3 月在公開活動中表示，預測市場讓那些不認同主流共識的人，能夠「用真金白銀來驗證自己的判斷」。
Shayne Coplan 將 Polymarket 形容為「觀測世界的實用溫度計」，能精準協助大眾評估未來事件發生的機率。他的長遠願景並不限於政治、選舉或重大新聞事件，而是希望打造一本涵蓋各類市場的「未來年鑑」（Almanac for the Future），提供各類事件發生機率的市場預測。
競爭白熱化！Coinbase 、 Robinhood 參戰，Kalshi 估值喊上 400 億
預測市場在美國正以前所未有的速度蓬勃發展，這股熱潮也吸引了眾多加密貨幣企業爭相搶食大餅。包含美國最大加密貨幣交易所 Coinbase（美股代號：COIN）以及深受散戶喜愛的網路券商羅賓漢（Robinhood，美股代號：HOOD），都已陸續將預測市場功能整合進自家的產品線中。
除了 Polymarket 外，其最大競爭對手 Kalshi 也積極展開募資。根據外媒報導，Kalshi 正尋求新一輪融資，公司估值目標高達 400 億美元，幾乎是上一輪募資估值的兩倍。
兩家公司雖然同樣經營預測市場，但商業模式卻有所不同。 Kalshi 採用美國聯邦監管的交易所架構，提供受監管的事件合約交易；而 Polymarket 則建立於區塊鏈基礎設施之上，並以加密貨幣完成交易結算，因此吸引更多加密資產投資人與鏈上交易者使用。
隨著傳統金融與加密貨幣市場同步加碼布局，預測市場正從小眾應用逐步走向主流，也讓 Polymarket 與 Kalshi 的競爭正式進入白熱化階段。

title: 美股狂飆創高、比特幣卻卡在 6.4 萬美元！荷姆茲海峽重啟能否帶動反彈？
summary:
全球股市在 AI 熱潮帶動下持續改寫歷史新高，但加密貨幣市場卻顯得格外冷清。比特幣今（5）日持續徘徊在 6.4 萬美元附近，即使投資人風險偏好升溫、油價回落、美債殖利率下滑等利多齊聚，卻未能帶動買盤回流加密貨幣市場。

〈美股狂飆創高、比特幣卻卡在 6.4 萬美元！荷姆茲海峽重啟能否帶動反彈？〉這篇文章最早發佈於《區塊客》。
full_text:
全球股市在 AI 熱潮帶動下持續改寫歷史新高，但加密貨幣市場卻顯得格外冷清。比特幣今（5）日持續徘徊在 6.4 萬美元附近，即使投資人風險偏好升溫、油價回落、美債殖利率下滑等利多齊聚，卻未能帶動買盤回流加密貨幣市場。
投資人接下來將聚焦美國、伊朗與阿曼是否就重新開放荷姆茲海峽（Strait of Hormuz）達成協議。分析人士指出，若這項重大地緣政治利多落地，比特幣仍無法有效反彈，恐意味目前市場買盤重心已轉向其他資產。
比特幣橫盤整理，多數主流幣漲跌有限
根據 CoinGecko 行情報價，比特幣寫稿時報 64,117 美元，單日漲幅不到 1%，近一周表現幾乎持平；其他加密貨幣走勢同樣平淡，以太幣報 1,864 美元，過去一周下跌約 2%，為主要幣種中表現最弱；瑞波幣（XRP）單日下跌近 1%，報 1.07 美元；Solana（SOL）持平於 73.6 美元附近；BNB 則漲逾 1% 至 598 美元，過去一周累計漲幅約 5% 。
此外，去中心化永續合約交易所 Hyperliquid 的原生代幣 HYPE 表現最為亮眼，單日上漲約 4.8% 至 56.63 美元，單周漲幅則維持在 3% 附近。
AI 熱潮推升全球股市，再創歷史新高
與加密貨幣市場形成鮮明對比的是，全球股市持續受到 AI 題材帶動。 MSCI 全球股票指數（MSCI All Country World Index）上漲 0.4%，逼近歷史收盤新高；MSCI 亞太指數則大漲 2.2% 。繼標普 500 指數、道瓊工業指數於周二雙雙創下歷史新高後，澳洲股市也接力飆出新天價。
焦點個股方面，韓國記憶體大廠 SK 海力士（SK Hynix）開盤大漲 6.4%，AI 晶片霸主輝達（Nvidia）盤後接續上揚逾 2% 。不過，市場並非全面狂歡，超微（AMD）因銷售前景黯淡而重挫 9%，而 SpaceX 則因 AI 資本支出遠超預期，股價大幅回檔 7.5% 。
荷姆茲海峽協議有望達成，油價回落
總體經濟與原物料方面，據美媒《Axios》報導，美國、伊朗與阿曼即將達成重啟荷姆茲海峽（Strait of Hormuz）的協議，並有望在周三正式發布聲明。
受消息影響，布蘭特原油（Brent crude）應聲下跌 1.1% 至每桶約 78.50 美元。同時，隨著交易員降低對美國聯準會（Fed）進一步升息的預期，美國公債與黃金雙雙震盪走高。
油價下跌、升息預期降溫，加上股市資金展現強烈的風險偏好，這些通常有利於風險資產的總經利多，如今卻連續 3 個交易日無法激勵加密貨幣市場。這項警訊暗示，加密貨幣市場目前的疲軟，問題出在「內部籌碼與動能匱乏」，而非受總體經濟環境拖累。
目前，比特幣仍較去年 10 月創下的約 12.6 萬美元歷史高點回落約 49%；以太幣本周也持續走弱，反映市場資金仍未重返主流加密資產。
分析人士認為，本周最大的觀察重點，將是荷姆茲海峽協議是否正式落地。若協議宣布後，比特幣依舊無法展開反彈，將進一步證明目前市場資金正流向 AI 概念股等其他風險資產，而非加密貨幣市場。

title: Police chief considers joining legal action over PC Harper killers' early release
summary: Two of PC Andrew Harper's killers are set to be included in the government's early release scheme, which begins in October.
full_text:
Police chief considers joining legal action over PC Harper killers' early release
- Published
The chief constable of Thames Valley Police says he will consider joining legal action to block the release of two of PC Andrew Harper's killers.
Chief Constable Jason Hogg told the BBC he was in discussion with the Police Federation of England and Wales over the matter, adding public opinion on their potential release was "overwhelming".
PC Harper, who served with Thames Valley, was killed in 2019 when he was dragged by a car down a country road as three teenagers fled the scene of a quad bike theft in Berkshire.
The two passengers in the car, Jessie Cole and Albert Bowers, were sentenced in 2020 to 13 years for manslaughter and could apply for early release after serving half of their sentences.
The driver of the vehicle, Henry Long, received a 16-year sentence and is not eligible for early release.
Speaking on the Today programme, Thames Valley Police chief Jason Hogg urged the government to reconsider its position.
Only prisoners convicted of murder, rape, grooming, and serious child sex offences will be excluded from the scheme in England and Wales - while those convicted of manslaughter remain eligible.
"I fully understand the challenges around the crisis in the prison system," he said.
"But the decision made and where that line has been drawn, I do not believe that people responsible for taking the life of another citizen in our country should be released early."
He said on Wednesday: "I was informed yesterday that the Police Federation are considering legal action, I am in discussions with the Police Federation with regards to this matter".
Asked whether this meant he would join them, he said: "I think we need to get some legal advice in relation to this. This is something I certainly would consider."
After campaigning by PC Harper's wife Lissie following his death, Parliament passed "Harper's Law", which gives mandatory life sentences to the killers of emergency services workers. It doubles the maximum penalty from 12 months to two years for those who assault police or other emergency workers.
But the new rules - introduced in 2022 - did not apply in the sentencing of the police officer's killers, and so do not prevent them from being released early.
Hogg said: "The law isn't retrospective and we all understand that, but the fact that they are released early simply seems perverse."
Aileen O'Connor, branch chair of Thames Valley Police Federation also told the BBC her organisation was considering legal action.
"We are in talks this morning, I'll get an update this afternoon whether that is an avenue that we can explore and if it is an avenue we can explore then I'll get behind that 110%," she told BBC Breakfast.
As for what shape a potential legal challenge might take, she said: "Ultimately that's for the specialists, the barristers and those in that legal sector to make that decision whether there is a challenge there.
"If there is a challenge then we will look to take that challenge."
Sentencing Minister Jake Richards told the BBC it would be wrong to pick out individual cases and block two of PC Harper's killers from early release.
Although the government had reviewed what sentences would be excluded from the early release scheme, he confirmed "manslaughter is not one of those offences".
Richards said: "It would be wrong to pick out individual cases within different offending cohorts. That wouldn't be right. It wouldn't be lawful either. So it is correct that those two individuals will be subject to the new regime from October".
On Tuesday Justice Secretary Alex Norris warned a prison capacity crisis would be likely if fewer prisoners were allowed early release.
Norris apologised to families who would be affected by the early release scheme and stressed that the government wanted to go further "but we cannot".
"We have to make this decision, we've been able to make some changes to it, but we have to have the rest of the sentencing act changes otherwise we run out of prison places in November and that can't happen," he said.
The justice secretary said 5,000 extra releases will take place in 10 batches from October.
Approximately 1,000 prisoners will now not be released early following the revision to the scheme, he clarified.
The government also announced an extra £10m will go to front-line victim support services, including a new national helpline.
