title: Meteor Showers, Eclipses, and More Are on the August 2026 Astronomical Calendar
summary: Here’s when some of this year’s most anticipated astronomical events will happen and the best way to observe them.
full_text:
For astronomy enthusiasts, August 2026 will be a month to remember. Some of the most spectacular celestial phenomena—including ones that are easy to observe without telescopes or other specialized equipment—will all occur during the same week.
It’s a great time to get your viewing plans together and start refreshing your weather app to see whether the skies will be clear where you are to catch all the happenings in the heavens.
Perseid Meteor Shower
The Perseids are among the most spectacular meteor showers of the year, along with the Geminids in December and the Quadrantids in January. Every August, Earth passes through the trail of particles left behind by Comet 109P/Swift-Tuttle. As the fragments enter the atmosphere at high speed, they produce an intense meteor shower.
In 2026, activity will peak during the night of Wednesday, August 12, and extend into the early morning hours of the following day. It will coincide with the new moon. That means the sky will be exceptionally dark, offering prime viewing conditions.
The Perseids appear to radiate from the constellation Perseus. In reality, the meteors can streak across any part of the sky, but locating that constellation with the help of a stargazing app can make it easier to know where to look for the best chance of catching streaks across the night sky.
Solar Eclipse
The main astronomical event of the month will be a total solar eclipse. Not everyone will get a glimpse, though, with the path of totality crossing sliver of Spain, Portugal, Iceland, and Greenland. Areas outside those locations will still be treated to a partial eclipse.
The timing will be particularly dramatic, with totality set to occur at sunset on August 12. The Sun’s low position above the horizon will offer an unusual—and photogenic—scene.
This will be the Iberian Peninsula’s first time seeing a total solar eclipse in more than a century. Madrid is in the path of totality as are regions that include Galicia, Asturias, Castile and León, Madrid, Aragon, Catalonia, Valencia, and the Balearic Islands. In the rest of the country, the eclipse will be partial.
Those outside the eclipse path will also be able to follow the event. Agencies such as NASA and the European Space Agency will broadcast the event live. The main piece of advice for those trying to observe it: Do not under any circumstances stare directly at the sun.
Planetary Alignment
As if the solar eclipse and the meteor shower weren’t enough, in the early morning hours of August 12, an alignment of six planets will also occur. Jupiter, Mercury, Mars, Uranus, Saturn, and Neptune will form an apparent line in the sky.
Observing this alignment is more challenging than watching the meteor shower given the faintness of some of the planets. However, if atmospheric conditions are favorable, it will be possible to see Mercury, Mars, and Saturn with the naked eye near the horizon shortly before sunrise. To observe Uranus and Neptune, you’ll need a telescope.
Lunar Eclipse
August 27 will close out the month with a partial lunar eclipse that will cover up to 96 percent of the moon’s disk. Unlike solar eclipses, which only cuts a very narrow path across the Earth’s surface, lunar eclipses can be seen from much larger regions of the planet. On this occasion, it will be visible across virtually the entirety of the Americas, from Canada to Argentina.
Also unlike this month’s solar eclipse, observing this one will require no special eye protection. Simply find a dark spot, away from light pollution and, if possible, with a clear horizon. The only protection you might need is from the cold, particularly if you’re in the southern hemisphere given the season.
This story originally appeared on WIRED en Español and has been translated from Spanish.

title: Best Android Charger: Wireless, Portable, Cable (2026)
summary: Whether you’re charging overnight at home or on the go, these are the fastest, most dependable Android chargers we’ve tested.
full_text:
The best Android charger might seem obvious, but it can depend heavily on your priorities. Do you want to charge your phone from zero to 100 as quickly as possible? Are you charging at home in bed overnight, or on the go in a hotel? WIRED Reviews staffers are constantly testing Android chargers, and below you'll find our top recommendations for every situation.
There was once a time when different phones required different cords, like Lightning cables for iPhone or Micro-USB for Android. But now, the majority of devices don't have special ports and just use a USB-C cable. Modern smartphones from Apple, Google, and Samsung use the Power Delivery charging standard, a fast-charging protocol for USB-C that supports higher voltage and wattage to charge phones faster. All the chargers below support USB-C PD and will work with any smartphone ecosystem, including iPhone.
Be sure to check out our related buying guides, like the Best Wireless Chargers, the Best Power Banks, and the Best 3-in-1 Chargers.
Love WIRED? Add us as a preferred source on Google to see more of us.
The Best Android Chargers
This USB-C wall charger can reach up to 45 watts, which will top off the vast majority of Android smartphones as quickly as possible. Some Android phones can handle speeds of 60 or even 100 watts, but unless your device specifically supports that, this should get you everything you need. We like the foldable prongs and the included 6-foot USB-C cable—a rarity these days. There is a newer version of this charger available with no cable and a built-in display, but we haven't tested it yet.
This power bank is going to be overkill for most smartphones, but it has a massive 25,000-mAh capacity and can easily top off your laptop and tablet, as well as your phone multiple times. If you're going to invest in a power bank, you might as well invest in a model that offers more than you need rather than less. The built-in display and cables are great, and it can top off four devices simultaneously. You can find more recommendations in our Power Bank Buying Guide.
This Qi2 power bank works similarly to MagSafe, except with Android. Not all Android phones are Qi2 compatible, but most will work with this power bank. They just might charge a little slower than the base 15 watts. Wireless chargers are slow in general, but they can still come in handy. This one has a kickstand, a built-in display, a two-way USB-C port, and a few interesting color options. We have more recommendations in our Qi2 Power Bank Buying Guide.
Our favorite USB-C charging cable measures 6 feet long and is durable. It offers charging up to 240 watts and is made of recycled plastic, with ribbed cuffs that are easy to grip. It is also backed by a lifetime warranty. It can be easy to accumulate a lot of nonsense junk cables that just work OK, but this will work well for years and won't fray the first time you look at it a little funny.
How Fast Can My Android Phone Charge?
Charging speeds depend on the equipment you use. If you aren't using cables or wireless chargers that can handle these speeds, your experience may vary. The same goes for your phone usage—if you're using your phone while it's charging, or while it's hot, or both, your speeds might diminish. But generally, the maximum charging speeds are as follows:
- Google Pixel 10: 45 watts (wired, Pro XL), 30 watts (wired, 10, 10a, and 10 Pro)
- Samsung Galaxy S26: 60 watts (wired, Galaxy S26 Ultra), 45 watts (wired, most Plus and Ultra models), 25 watts (wired, most base models)
Top charging speeds depend heavily on which phone you're using. Read more about fast charging here.
What Wattage Do I Need?
Truly, at the end of the day, it doesn't matter that much. A 15-watt charger is the bare minimum we'd recommend, and it will work just fine to charge your phone in a couple of hours, which is better for long-term battery health and perfect for charging overnight or while you're chilling on the couch. If you need as much juice as fast as possible, a 40-watt charger will do the trick and can get most newer smartphones to 80 percent charged in about half an hour. Most of us prefer to have a couple of different options around to use situationally. Note that you shouldn't use a charger under 15 watts unless your device specifically calls for it. It'll just be slow and frustrating otherwise.
Why Aren’t There Any Multi-Device Chargers In This Guide?
Unlike the handy 3-in-1 chargers for iPhone, Android phones simply aren't unified enough for there to be a top pick in this category. Samsung users have options that can work with Galaxy Watch and Galaxy Buds, for example, but not every Samsung owner uses all of those devices. You can check our 3-in-1 chargers guide for picks that will work with some Android phones in case you use an Apple Watch and AirPods.

full_text:
為了在白熱化的人工智慧（AI）軍備競賽中保持絕對領先，科技巨頭 Alphabet（Google 母公司）正大舉籌措資金！據《Yahoo Finance》報導，Alphabet 於今（6）日正式進入美國企業債券市場，計畫透過發行 10 檔涵蓋不同期限的基準債券，募集最高達 250 億美元的巨額資金，主要將投入擴建資料中心與 AI 伺服器等基礎設施。
（前情提要：Google 首席科學家 Jeff Dean 是誰？離職竟讓 Alphabet 蒸發 1900 億美元）
（背景補充：Google AI 高層大洗牌！Hassabis 升任首席科學家專攻 AGI，AI 元老 Jeff Dean 離職創業）
在人工智慧（AI）技術的快速發展下，全球科技巨頭對算力與基礎設施的資金需求正急遽膨脹。台北時間 8 月 6 日，據外媒《Yahoo Finance》報導，Alphabet（股票代碼 GOOGL/GOOG）正式啟動了一項規模龐大的融資計畫，進入美國企業債券市場並推出 10 檔基準債券的發行，預計藉此籌措最高達 250 億美元的資金。
瞄準 AI 軍備競賽，大舉上修資本支出
儘管 Alphabet 一直被外界視為現金充裕的科技巨頭，看似不需對外借款，但在激烈的 AI 競爭下，該公司目前正處於歷史性的資本支出（Capex）高峰期。根據其最新公布的第二季財報顯示，Alphabet 已將 2026 全年的資本支出預估，大幅上調至 1,950 億至 2,050 億美元的驚人規模。
這筆高達 250 億美元的發債籌資，將主要投入於擴建資料中心、增加伺服器產能以及強化半導體基礎設施，以全力支援旗下 Gemini AI 模型與雲端服務的快速擴張。透過發行債券，Alphabet 得以在巨額的實體建設投資與日常營運現金需求之間取得平衡，同時有效優化整體的資本成本。
發行 10 檔基準債券，期限最長達 40 年
根據報導，這是一筆向美國證券交易委員會（SEC）註冊的高級無擔保債券，結構設計相當多元，旨在吸引從短期資金管理者到長期退休基金等各類型的固定收益投資人。該交易涵蓋了從 2 年到 40 年的不同到期期限，並同步提供了固定利率與連結擔保隔夜融資利率（SOFR）的浮動利率選項。
在初步定價討論中，短期端的 2 年期（到期日 2028 年 8 月 15 日）與 3 年期固定利率債券，相對於美國公債的利差分別約為 +60 個基點（bps）與 +70 個基點；中期端的 5 年期與 7 年期則約落在 +85 個基點與 +100 個基點。
頂級信評護體，鎖定低資金成本
在長期端方面，10 年期基準債券的利差約為 +110 個基點，而最長的超長期 40 年期（到期日為 2066 年 8 月 15 日）債券，利差則來到 +155 個基點左右。值得注意的是，所有固定利率檔次均包含了提前贖回補償條款（Make-whole call），並設有到期前 1 至 6 個月的標準平價贖回窗口。
憑藉著預期高達 Aa2 / AA+ 的頂級信用評級，Alphabet 成功利用目前有利的市場條件，以極具成本效益的方式籌措資金。這項大規模的融資行動，不僅展現了 Alphabet 擴張雲端與 AI 基礎設施的強烈企圖心，也反映出科技巨頭正積極運用強大的資產負債表，為未來的科技霸權鋪路。

full_text:
美國經濟衰退疑慮煙消雲散？據外媒《Investing.com》報導，知名金融研究機構 Yardeni Research 在最新發布的報告中指出，受惠於 AI 基礎建設的鉅額投資與強勁的消費支出，美國經濟雙引擎正「蓬勃發展」。該機構強調，目前的通膨上行風險已遠大於經濟下行風險，呼籲聯準會（Fed）官員應放棄降息幻想，轉向更為鷹派的政策立場。
（前情提要：施壓聯準會救日圓？美財長籲擴大 FIMA 回購上限，聯準會傳聲筒：搞錯工具用途）
（背景補充：Arthur Hayes：聯準會本週 H.4.1 報告揭密日本日債抵押通道）
在全球市場屏息以待聯準會（Fed）降息時機之際，華爾街重量級研究機構卻拋出了截然不同的觀點。台北時間 8 月 6 日，據外媒《Investing.com》報導，Yardeni Research 在週四發布的最新研究報告中直言，美國經濟基礎目前依然十分穩固，因此聯準會官員應該採取更為鷹派的立場。該機構的核心理據在於：當前通膨再度上行的風險，已明顯大於經濟成長陷入衰退的下行風險。
消費與企業投資雙引擎「蓬勃發展」
Yardeni 的報告指出，美國經濟的兩大核心引擎 —— 消費支出與企業投資，目前正處於「蓬勃發展（Are booming）」的狀態。數據顯示，美國第二季實質消費成長達到 3.3%，而非住宅固定投資更是出現 8.4% 的大幅成長。
與此同時，通膨數據依然頑強。第二季的 GDP 平減指數（Headline）年增率達 4.3%，核心 GDP 平減指數也維持在 3.8% 的高位。基於這些強勁的經濟數據，Yardeni 強烈建議聯準會官員應該轉向鷹派，以防範通膨死灰復燃。
AI 資本支出猶如「獨立經濟刺激計畫」
值得注意的是，Yardeni 將美國經濟的強韌歸功於人工智慧（AI）浪潮帶來的鉅額資本支出。報告引述美國銀行（Bank of America）的預估數據指出，超大規模資料中心業者（Hyperscalers）在今年的資本支出預計將高達 8,600 億美元，且到了 2027 年，這個數字極有可能逼近 1.2 兆美元大關。
Yardeni 形容，這些與 AI 相關的龐大資本支出，實質上已經成為美國經濟的一項「獨立刺激計畫」，若再加上美國政府赤字支出所帶來的刺激效果，整體經濟獲得了極強的下檔支撐。儘管 7 月份的 ADP 就業報告表現偏弱（僅新增 4.4 萬個私人部門職位），但 Yardeni 認為這並未推翻其對就業持續成長的情境預測；且服務業活動依然堅挺，PMI 指數微升至 54.1，其中的「價格支付」指標更顯示出偏熱跡象。
Fed 內部分裂，鷹派官員頻發聲
面對如此複雜的經濟數據，聯準會內部似乎也陷入了路線分裂。報告觀察到，Fed 官員目前分成兩派：一派堅持只有在通膨無法朝 2% 目標穩定下降時才需要升息；另一派則呼籲應更早採取行動。
文章特別引述了近期較為鷹派的官員發言。例如，明尼亞波利斯聯準銀行總裁 Neel Kashkari 就曾暗示，今年再次升息「並非不可能（Not impossible）」；堪薩斯城聯準銀行總裁 Jeff Schmid 也強調，目前的通膨狀況「需要更緊的政策（Require tighter policy）」來應對。從金融市場目前的反應來看，2 年期美債殖利率仍明顯高於聯邦基金利率，顯示市場資金也正傾向於聯準會將維持更長時間的鷹派立場。

title: 慎防去風險化拋售！分析師揭比特幣週期魔咒：每月 5 號常爆反向行情
summary:
比特幣價格是否即將迎來變盤？據知名加密貨幣交易員 KillaXBT 於 X 平台發布的最新分析指出，比特幣即將 […]

〈慎防去風險化拋售！分析師揭比特幣週期魔咒：每月 5 號常爆反向行情〉這篇文章最早發佈於動區BlockTempo《動區動趨-最具影響力的區塊鏈新聞媒體》。
full_text:
比特幣價格是否即將迎來變盤？據知名加密貨幣交易員 KillaXBT 於 X 平台發布的最新分析指出，比特幣即將進入每月 5 號附近的關鍵「Pivot（轉折點）」日期。他警告，根據過去一年半的歷史數據，這段期間的市場走勢往往會與主流敘事背道而馳，投資人需提防潛在的「去風險（de-risking）」下殺行情。
（前情提要：礦企 Cipher Digital 上半年狂賣 1,619 枚比特幣！慘賠 4,770 萬鎂，急轉型 AI 資料中心求生）
（背景補充：比特幣漲回 6.4 萬鎂沒有新錢進場！8.5 萬枚 BTC 沉睡，反彈全靠沒人賣）
加密貨幣市場的波動往往暗藏著某些難以察覺的週期性規律。台北時間 8 月 6 日，擁有 7 年量化交易經驗的知名分析師 KillaXBT 在社群平台 X 上發文，針對比特幣（BTC）近期的價格走勢發出了關鍵的變盤警告。他指出，隨著 8 月初行情的推進，市場即將面臨一個極為關鍵的時間節點 —— 也就是所謂的「第 5 個 Pivot」。
The 5th Pivot
As mentioned in my monthly open pivot post, we saw the expected pump at the start of the month, which played out as anticipated.
Now, we're pushing into the 5th Pivot, a key date to watch. Over the past 1.5 years, simply inversing the prevailing narrative… pic.twitter.com/dZIvjNDpzl
— Killa (@KillaXBT) August 6, 2026
歷史重演？Pivot 期間常現反向行情
在 KillaXBT 附上的價格走勢圖表中，他將過去一年半（自 2025 年 12 月起）每個月 5 號左右的日期特別標示為「Pivot（轉折點）」。透過紅綠圓點的對比可以發現，這些特定日期往往伴隨著比特幣價格的相對高點或低點。
KillaXBT 在貼文中分析指出：「在過去的 1.5 年裡，只要簡單地在這個時期採取與『當前主流敘事』相反的操作，就能多次捕捉到 3% 至 4% 的反向波段利潤。他進一步警告，如果這種歷史模式在本次（8 月 5 日前後）繼續發威，市場極有可能在經歷本月初的預期上漲後，迎來一波「去風險化（de-risking）」的拋售走勢。
當前結構複雜，慎防洗盤震盪
儘管歷史數據暗示著反向作空的勝率頗高，但 KillaXBT 也特別提醒投資人，目前的市場環境比起以往更加棘手。他回顧了上一次發生類似情況時的盤面發展：「雖然當時我們確實迎來了預期中的下跌，但價格卻陷入了一個極為困難的區間內進行交易。
這意味著，市場並沒有給出一個乾脆俐落的下跌趨勢，而是演變成劇烈洗盤（choppy price action），比特幣隨後便進入了漫長的盤整期，直到下一個 Pivot 日期到來。因此，他總結道，雖然歷史傾向支持「反向操作」，但在當前的複雜環境下，深入分析市場結構的重要性絕對不亞於單純的週期預測。他也重申，這份分析僅供教育用途，不應被視為正式的財務建議。

title: 美銀 BofA 一年砸 2.5 億鎂幫員工打瘦瘦針！執行長：明知人會跑，還是好投資
summary:
美國銀行執行長 Brian Moynihan 8 月 5 日接受 CNBC 節目主持人 Andrew Ross […]

〈美銀 BofA 一年砸 2.5 億鎂幫員工打瘦瘦針！執行長：明知人會跑，還是好投資〉這篇文章最早發佈於動區BlockTempo《動區動趨-最具影響力的區塊鏈新聞媒體》。
full_text:
美國銀行執行長 Brian Moynihan 8 月 5 日接受 CNBC 節目主持人 Andrew Ross Sorkin 訪問時透露，該行每年花費超過 2.5 億美元，為員工給付 GLP-1 減重藥物。美銀約有 21.1 萬名員工、年度醫療支出超過 20 億美元，等於光是瘦瘦針一項就吃掉整體醫療預算的 13%，而這個數字在四五年前是零。他坦承有些員工可能在公司享受到長期健康效益之前就離職，但仍認為這是一筆好投資。同時間全美雇主正在往相反方向走。
（前情提要：研究》瘦瘦針能治好女性的「失業問題」？和新對象交往機率也激增）
（背景補充：減肥藥龍頭禮來傳出搶進「迷幻藥」！欲收購 ATAI 暴漲 66%，致幻藥物為何突然正夯？）
重點摘要
- 美銀年花逾 2.5 億美元給付員工 GLP-1，佔其 20 億美元醫療支出約 13%。
- 執行長 Brian Moynihan 坦承部分員工可能提早離職，仍稱這是好投資。
- 全美近半不給付的雇主表示「不管什麼價格都不會給付」，趨勢正好相反。
這是一則看起來有點奇怪的消息，但結構蠻簡單的，大企業省錢的方式是先花錢。美國資產規模第二大的銀行，一年花在員工施打瘦瘦針上的錢是 2.5 億美元。
美國銀行執行長 Brian Moynihan 8 月 5 日在 CNBC 節目上，對主持人 Andrew Ross Sorkin 講出這個頗驚人的數字。
我們在 GLP 上花大約 2.5 億美元甚至更多，而這是從零開始的。我們看到對員工產生了很大的影響。
美銀約有 21.1 萬名員工，每年醫療相關支出撥出超過 20 億美元。換算下來，GLP-1 針劑就佔掉整體醫療預算的 13%，平均攤到每位員工身上，一年大約 1,185 美元。四五年前這個項目根本不存在。
從零到 2.5 億只花了四五年
成本曲線陡到什麼程度，產業數據講得更清楚。國際員工福利計畫基金會（IFEBP）7 月發布的調查顯示，GLP-1 藥物佔雇主年度理賠的比例，已經從 2023 年的 6.9% 升到 2026 年的 11.4%，三年幾乎翻倍。這份調查涵蓋超過 30,000 家會員企業與公共機構。
Moynihan 說美銀正在動用規模去壓價。
相信我，我們正在跟所有人殺價，想壓到越便宜越好。但我們的看法是，考慮到長期的健康效益，加上可能還有更多短期的健康效益，這是一筆好投資。
他所謂的短期效益，指的是近期陸續出爐的臨床數據，包括心血管事件發生率下降。美銀也把藥物給付跟健康教練綁在一起，協助員工追蹤體重與生活習慣的變化。Moynihan 形容看著同事們的行為調整與體重減輕「非常有意思」。
至於這筆錢能不能收得回來，他講得相當坦白，有些員工可能在公司實現長期健康節省之前就離開了，但這個決定終究反映的是提供有價值福利這件事本身。等於他承認這 2.5 億裡有一部分，是在替員工未來的雇主先付的。
大企業正在集體取消這筆預算
美銀的做法之所以值得寫，是因為整個市場正在往反方向走。以下數據是美國。
一份針對 235 家以上雇主、保險計畫與工會福利主管的調查顯示，在目前不給付減重用 GLP-1 的公司裡，將近一半（49%）表示「不管什麼價格都不會給付」。從 2025 到 2026 年，約有 1,200 萬人失去 Zepbound 的給付、另有 1,200 萬人失去 Wegovy 的給付，目前超過 1.14 億美國人的保險完全不涵蓋 Zepbound，比 2025 年再多出 1,700 萬人。保險商 Cigna 近期也停掉了這兩款藥的給付。
給付與否幾乎跟公司規模成正比。5,000 人以上的企業有 43% 給付減重用途的 GLP-1，1,000 至 4,999 人的降到 30%，200 至 999 人的只剩 16%。IFEBP 的數字則顯示，同時給付糖尿病與減重用途的雇主約 36%，比 2024 年的 34% 微升，但跟 2025 年相比是持平的，成長已經停住。
藥廠當然想扭轉這件事，禮來今年 3 月推出新方案，讓雇主能以每月 449 美元的淨折扣價，取得新的多劑量型 Zepbound 且所有劑量同價。若拿這個價格回推，2.5 億美元大約相當於 4.6 萬人用滿一整年，約當美銀員工數的兩成出頭。這只是概算，美銀並未公布實際用藥人數與談到的折扣。
在台灣吃自己吧
對台灣讀者來說，這則新聞的參照點是自費金額。
目前台灣的 GLP-1 減重藥物並未納入健保給付，用於體重管理的適應症屬於自費療程。市面行情大致是 Wegovy（週纖達）每月約新台幣 9,900 元至 1.8 萬元，Mounjaro（猛健樂）每月約 1.2 萬元至 1.8 萬元，實際價格依診所報價、劑量與是否含醫師評估、抽血、營養衛教而異。
換句話說，美銀員工由公司買單的這件事，在台灣打一年大約要自掏 12 萬到 21 萬元。當美國企業在爭論這筆錢該不該由雇主出的時候，台灣的討論還停在薪水夠不夠自己打。
常見問題
美銀為什麼願意花 2.5 億美元給員工打瘦瘦針？
執行長 Brian Moynihan 給的理由是長期預防性健康效益，加上近期臨床數據顯示心血管事件發生率下降等較短期的好處。美銀同時搭配健康教練服務，並運用規模向藥廠與藥品福利管理業者議價。
其他企業也在跟進嗎？
趨勢相反。約 36% 雇主給付 GLP-1，較 2025 年持平；不給付的公司中有 49% 表示不管什麼價格都不會給付。2025 至 2026 年間各有約 1,200 萬人失去 Zepbound 與 Wegovy 的給付。

研究》瘦瘦針能治好女性的「失業問題」？和新對象交往機率也激增

title: Cloudflare Wallets 錢包申請教學》5 分鐘搶下 cloudflare.pay 名稱，入金、支付要等等
summary:
這篇帶你 5 分鐘搶下一個 cloudflare.pay 錢包名稱，只要一組免費 Cloudflare 帳號就 […]

〈Cloudflare Wallets 錢包申請教學》5 分鐘搶下 cloudflare.pay 名稱，入金、支付要等等〉這篇文章最早發佈於動區BlockTempo《動區動趨-最具影響力的區塊鏈新聞媒體》。
full_text:
這篇帶你 5 分鐘搶下一個 cloudflare.pay 錢包名稱，只要一組免費 Cloudflare 帳號就能做，總共 3 個步驟。同時會講清楚哪些功能現在還不能用，免得你照著別的整理文到處找「入金」按鈕，找到懷疑人生。
（前情提要：Cloudflare 推出「AI 代理專用錢包」！支援穩定幣微支付、自訂預算防超支）
（背景補充：Visa、Mastercard 搶進「AI 代理支付」管道，但至今交易額僅 1.36 億鎂）
重點摘要
- 目前只有 handle（錢包名稱）預約上線，入金與付款功能官方說「接下來幾個月」才到
- 申請只要免費 Cloudflare 帳號，3 個步驟、約 5 分鐘搞定
- Cloudflare 明講保留拒絕任何名稱預約的權利，搶到不等於一定給你
Cloudflare 在 8 月 4 日開放了 Cloudflare Wallets 的名稱預約。這篇適合兩種人看，一種是想先把好名字卡住的人，一種是被各種「AI 代理錢包」標題吸引、想知道現在到底能不能用的人。
先講結論，現在能做的只有搶錢包註冊名字，錢包本身還不能用。
點這邊進入》 https://cloudflare.pay/
現在能做的只有搶名字
這一段最重要，因為網路上不少整理文把官方的未來式寫成了現在式。
Cloudflare 官方公告的原句是這樣：從今天起你可以為你的帳號 claim 一個 Cloudflare Wallet handle，而「不久之後」你才能設定並使用你的 Cloudflare Wallet 來支付 API 與內容。cloudflare.pay 頁面上寫得更直白，選一個你的專屬錢包名稱，然後「為上線預留」它。
所以現在的狀態很清楚：
- ✅ 已開放: handle（錢包名稱，你在這個系統裡的專屬帳號代號）預約
- ❌ 還沒開放: 儲值穩定幣、實際付款
- ❌ 還沒開放: 建立 Virtual Wallet（虛擬錢包，發給 AI 代理用的子錢包）
- ❌ 還沒開放: 設定護欄，也就是額度上限、允許往來的商家白名單、單筆交易上限這三項
我自己實際點進 cloudflare.pay 看過，整個頁面就是讓你挑名字跟預約，沒有任何入金或建立錢包的入口。如果你照著某些教學去找「新增資金」按鈕，你會找不到，因為那個東西還沒生出來。開發者檔案的 wallets 路徑目前也還是 404。
三個步驟把 handle 搶下來
前置條件只有一個，你要有 Cloudflare 帳號，免費方案就可以，不需要付費升級。
- Step 1: 沒帳號的話先去 dash.cloudflare.com/sign-up 註冊。填 email 跟密碼，按下 Create Account，官方流程就這三下。
- Step 2: 去收信。Cloudflare 會自動寄一封驗證信到你填的信箱，點下去把 email 驗證完成，帳號才算真的能用。
- Step 3: 開啟 cloudflare.pay ，用剛才的帳號登入，輸入你想要的錢包名稱送出預約。
如果你是幫團隊或公司申請，這邊要注意，Cloudflare 官方建議帳號 email 用群組信箱或通訊群組（例如 [email protected]），不要綁在某個人的個人信箱上。這種事情當下無所謂，等到那個人離職就會變得很麻煩。
名稱本身建議想清楚再註冊，因為這是一個公開的名稱，之後 AI 代理跟商家往來時可以選擇性亮出自己的來源網域，格式長得像 xxx.xxx，等於你的名字會被別人看到。
搶完之後還缺什麼
送出預約之後不會有錢包給你，就是把名字鎖住不讓別人註冊而已，其餘功能要等 Cloudflare 後續開放。
這邊有個容易被忽略的地雷，Cloudflare 在 cloudflare.pay 頁面上明講，保留基於任何理由拒絕錢包名稱預約的權利。所以搶到不等於一定拿得到，尤其如果你去卡一個知名品牌或商標的名稱，被官方收回的機率不低。
至於這套東西之後要拿來幹嘛，可以看它接的另外兩塊。Cloudflare 這個月稍早發布了 Monetization Gateway（變現閘道），讓網站與應用程式可以直接向 AI 代理收費，走的是 x402 協定（把付款直接附加在 HTTP 請求上的機制）。錢包就是這個市場的另一半，一邊收錢一邊付錢。身分那一塊則是跟 Web Bot Auth（機器人身分驗證）整合，讓代理能證明自己代表誰。
如果你看到這邊還有興趣，現在就去 cloudflare.pay 註冊，把名字卡住，其他等通知。
附錄：官方資源
- cloudflare.pay 預約錢包名稱的唯一官方入口，登入後直接輸入想要的名稱。
- Cloudflare Wallets 官方公告 8 月 4 日發布，說明 Account Wallet 與 Virtual Wallet 的設計、三種護欄，以及未來的功能規劃。
- Cloudflare 註冊頁 沒帳號的話從這裡開始，免費方案就足夠申請 handle。
- Cloudflare 帳號設定檔案 官方的帳號建立說明，含團隊帳號用群組信箱的建議。
常見問題
Q1. 申請 handle 要付錢嗎？
A: 不用。免費 Cloudflare 帳號就能預約，不需要升級付費方案。
Q2. 預約完就能入金開始用了嗎？
A: 不行。目前只有名稱預約上線，儲值、付款、建立給 AI 代理的 Virtual Wallet 都還沒開放，官方說法是接下來幾個月才會陸續推出。
Q3. 我搶到的名字一定是我的嗎？
A: 不一定。Cloudflare 在頁面上明確保留基於任何理由拒絕預約的權利，去卡別人的品牌或商標名稱風險很高。
Q4. 這跟一般加密錢包有什麼不一樣？
A: 一般錢包是給人用的，Cloudflare Wallets 的重點在於讓 AI 代理有身分也有付款能力，主錢包歸人類持有，再切出受額度與白名單限制的子錢包給代理用。

title: 礦企 Cipher Digital 上半年狂賣 1,619 枚比特幣！慘賠 4,770 萬鎂，急轉型 AI 資料中心求生
summary:
比特幣礦業生存戰越演越烈！據 CryptoSlate 報導，知名礦企 Cipher Digital 在今年上半 […]

〈礦企 Cipher Digital 上半年狂賣 1,619 枚比特幣！慘賠 4,770 萬鎂，急轉型 AI 資料中心求生〉這篇文章最早發佈於動區BlockTempo《動區動趨-最具影響力的區塊鏈新聞媒體》。
full_text:
比特幣礦業生存戰越演越烈！據 CryptoSlate 報導，知名礦企 Cipher Digital 在今年上半年大舉拋售 1,619 枚比特幣，不僅承受高達 4,770 萬美元的已實現虧損，其利息支出更飆升至挖礦營收的 2.7 倍。為了突圍，Cipher 正全力衝刺 Black Pearl AI 資料中心業務，試圖在龐大的財務壓力下尋求生機。
（前情提要：熊底到了？比特幣礦企 PowerCompute 以 307 BTC 再融資 1800 萬美元）
（背景補充：川普家族礦企 American Bitcoin Q2 挖出 932 枚比特幣創新高！持倉 8000 枚 BTC 虧損大幅收窄）
在比特幣挖礦難度攀升與獎勵減半的雙重夾擊下，礦企正面臨前所未有的財務考驗。台北時間 8 月 6 日，據外媒 CryptoSlate 報導，比特幣礦企 Cipher Digital（Cipher）公布了 2026 年上半年的最新財務狀況，揭露了該公司為了維持營運流動性與轉型 AI 資料中心，不得不認賠拋售大量比特幣的窘境。
狂賣 1,619 枚 BTC，上半年慘賠逾 4,700 萬美元
財報數據顯示，Cipher 在 2026 年上半年總計出售了高達 1,619 枚比特幣，獲得約 1.234 億美元的現金。然而，這波拋售卻讓公司吞下了 4,770 萬美元的已實現虧損，其中光是第二季的虧損就佔了約 2,350 萬美元。截至 6 月底為止，Cipher 手上的比特幣儲備僅剩下 646 枚，市值約為 3,780 萬美元，顯示其面臨著不小的資金消耗壓力。
利息負擔沉重！Q2 淨虧損擴大至 2.67 億美元
Cipher 在本季度的營收表現同樣面臨逆風。第二季的營收完全依賴於 Odessa 的比特幣挖礦業務，與去年同期的 4,360 萬美元相比出現大幅下滑。總結上半年，其挖礦營收僅為 2,480 萬美元，但同期的利息支出卻高達 6,670 萬美元 —— 利息負擔足足是挖礦營收的 2.7 倍，凸顯了公司沉重的財務壓力。
為了支撐營運與基礎設施建設，Cipher 在上半年消耗了 1.52 億美元現金，並在物業與設備上投入了 9.643 億美元的鉅資。儘管透過股票銷售等融資活動淨流入了 28.4 億美元，但受到一筆與 Google 相關的 1.505 億美元非現金認股權證費用（屬於 Barber Lake 租約）拖累，導致 Cipher 第二季的淨虧損一舉擴大至 2.675 億美元。
押注 AI 資料中心，Black Pearl 成轉型關鍵
面對傳統挖礦業務的疲軟，Cipher 將未來的希望寄託在 AI 領域。報導指出，其備受矚目的 Black Pearl AI 資料中心租賃已於 6 月 30 日後開始計時，且公司在 8 月初已提前兩個月交付初始產能。不過，Cipher 目前尚未揭露已收到的具體租金金額與逐季的租金爬坡細節。
市場分析認為，Cipher 的處境反映了當前比特幣礦業的縮影：弱勢業者被迫拋售比特幣以維持生存，而具備資本實力的業者則積極透過發債與籌資，大舉進軍利潤更豐厚的 AI 資料中心市場。預計到今年第三季，Black Pearl 的完整租金收益才會正式入帳，屆時市場將能更準確地評估 Cipher 的 AI 轉型是否足以填補其高昂的建設支出與利息黑洞。

title: 中國官媒人民網：英文 AI 術語 Token、Agent 進入日常交流，將嚴重威脅國家科技話語權
summary:
在人工智慧（AI）席捲全球之際，科技名詞的翻譯也牽動著國家戰略神經。據人民網旗下《人民銳評》專欄 5 日發表的 […]

〈中國官媒人民網：英文 AI 術語 Token、Agent 進入日常交流，將嚴重威脅國家科技話語權〉這篇文章最早發佈於動區BlockTempo《動區動趨-最具影響力的區塊鏈新聞媒體》。
full_text:
在人工智慧（AI）席捲全球之際，科技名詞的翻譯也牽動著國家戰略神經。據人民網旗下《人民銳評》專欄 5 日發表的評論指出，大量未經本土化的英文術語如 Token、Agent 直接進入日常交流，不僅抬高民眾理解門檻，更嚴重威脅中國的科技話語權。文章強烈呼籲，全社會應積極推廣「詞元」、「智慧體」等標準中文譯名，以守住母語根基並建構自主的科技敘事體系。
（前情提要：美國財政部將檢視中國 AI 模型，貝森特：智財遭竊取會降下制裁）
（背景補充：中國 AI 巨頭 DeepSeek 傳最快年底 IPO 上市！尋求新一輪融資估值衝 710 億美元）
在人工智慧（AI）技術日新月異的今天，語言不僅是單純的溝通工具，更成為國家科技戰略競爭的隱形戰場。台北時間 8 月 5 日，中國官媒人民網旗下的「人民銳評」專欄發表了一篇由李瑋撰寫的評論文章，標題直指核心：《用“Token”還是“詞元”，事關科技話語權》。文章強烈警告，面對大量未經本土化轉化的英文前沿術語直接湧入大眾視野，若不積極應對，恐將導致母語體系被消解，進而喪失在 AI 領域的話語主動權。
英文術語氾濫，加劇社會「數位落差」
文章點出，漢語在歷史上展現了極大的包容與轉化能力，例如將 Computer 譯為「電腦」、Internet 譯為「網際網路」，精準貼合了漢語「形音義統一」的表意邏輯，並成功融入民族語言體系。然而，如今包括 Token、Agent（中國譯為智能體，台灣常用智慧體或代理）與 LLM（大型語言模型）等 AI 核心術語，卻僅以英文縮寫的形式頻繁出現在教材、政策與媒體之中。
人民網批評，這些單純的英文符號缺乏文化底蘊，讓一般大眾無法「望文生義」。這不僅大幅擠壓了漢語的表意空間，無形中抬高了民眾理解前沿科技的門檻，更進一步擴大了社會的數位落差，同時也逐步侵蝕著漢語體系的完整性與傳承性。
語言塑造思維，過度依賴恐失「科技話語權」
除了大眾傳播層面，文章更進一步強調了語言對國家科技自主發展的深遠影響。評論指出，語言塑造思維，若長期依附外來術語、照搬西方的語言邏輯，將使中國的科技認知被侷限於既定的西方框架內，難以孕育出真正貼合本土實踐的原創科技理論。
「術語是科技敘事的基礎單元，」文章嚴肅表示，如果核心概念的定義權與闡釋權始終掌握在他人手中，具有中國特色的科技話語體系將無從建立。這種在認知層面的依附，往往比實質的技術落後更加隱蔽，也對科技自立自強的長遠發展構成更大的威脅。
倡導分層有序：學術接軌，大眾推廣中文
不過，文章也澄清，規範科技用語絕非要走向封閉或排斥對外開放，而是要建構一個「分層有序」的語言使用體系。在國際學術交流與跨國合作的場合，仍應保留英文原詞以適應全球溝通；但在國內的公共傳播、教育教學與政策普及等通用場景，則必須大力推廣「詞元」、「智慧體」等標準的中文譯名。
為了築牢這道語言防線，人民網呼籲相關部門應優化術語審定機制，縮短規範譯名出爐與技術迭代之間的時間差。同時，媒體與科技企業應主動踐行規範表達，大專院校與科研機構更需率先示範，引導青年樹立母語自覺。

summary:

〈人形機器人第一股》宇樹科技科創板定價 150.8 元，估「中一籤狂賺 17 萬」〉這篇文章最早發佈於動區BlockTempo《動區動趨-最具影響力的區塊鏈新聞媒體》。
full_text:
備受市場矚目的「人形機器人第一股」宇樹科技（Unitree）確認將於科創板掛牌！據最新發行的官方公告，其 IPO 發行價正式敲定為每股 150.80 元人民幣，上市估值逼近 610 億元人民幣。值得注意的是，海外預 IPO 交易平台 Trade.xyz 上的合約報價已隱含逾 3 倍的開盤漲幅預期，引發打新市場高度關注。
（前情提要：宇樹科技IPO時間表確定，上市日期、估值與投資者需要知道的一切）
（背景補充：中國「宇樹科技」提交註冊IPO！73天閃電通關，衝刺A股機器人第一股）
在人工智慧與硬體結合的浪潮下，中國機器人產業迎來重大里程碑。台北時間 8 月 6 日，據宇樹科技（Unitree）最新發布的發行公告指出，發行人與保薦人（中信證券）依據初步詢價結果並綜合評估市場情況後，正式敲定本次科創板 IPO 的發行價格為每股 150.80 元人民幣，網下發行將不再進行累計投標詢價。網上與網下申購預計將於 8 月 10 日正式展開。
估值上看 610 億人民幣，定價大幅超越預期
根據公告的詳細數據，宇樹科技本次預計發行約 4,044.6 萬股，佔發行後總股本（約 4.04 億股）的 10%。若按 150.80 元人民幣的發行價計算，預計募集資金總額約為 60.99 億元人民幣（淨額約 59.17 億元）；這也意味著，其發行後的整體市值將高達約 609.93 億元人民幣。
值得注意的是，此前市場曾預估其定價約落在 104 元人民幣、市值約 400 億元人民幣以上。最終定價明顯高出市場預期，且對應的 2025 年相關市銷率和本益比也高於同業可比公司均值，反映出機構投資者對於「人形機器人第一股」未來的強烈看好，但也為後續的二級市場表現設下了較高的門檻。
預 IPO 平台熱炒，隱含逾 3 倍開盤溢價
儘管官方發行價已經不低，但海外加密貨幣與衍生品市場的炒作熱度更是驚人。在知名的預 IPO 永續合約交易平台 Trade.xyz 上，宇樹科技的合約報價近期已來到 74.62 美元（按匯率約合 503.7 元人民幣），對應的上市後市值預期高達 301.8 億美元（約 2,037 億元人民幣）。
若將該平台的交易價格與實際的 150.80 元發行價相比，隱含的開盤溢價高達 3.34 倍。這意味著，投資人若在 8 月 10 日成功中籤一手（500 股），在繳納約 7.54 萬元人民幣的認購成本後，按此預期價格計算，單手的潛在獲利空間將高達 17.6 萬至 17.7 萬元人民幣。
衍生品價格僅供參考，破發風險仍需警惕
宇樹科技作為四足與人形機器人領域的指標性企業，此次成功登陸科創板無疑為整體 AI 機器人板塊注入了強心針。然而，專家也提醒，Trade.xyz 等平台提供的預 IPO 永續合約本質上屬於衍生品，主要反映部分海外市場對上市後 A 股價格的炒作預期，並非實際的股份交易。
這類衍生品極易受到匯率、流動性匱乏與投機波動等因素干擾，過去也曾出現過大幅偏離實際開盤價的極端報價。在本次宇樹科技採取的「戰略配售+網下+網上」發行方式中，網上初始規模相對有限、中籤率預計極低；而對於幸運中籤的投資人來說，在高估值發行的背景下，實際開盤表現仍取決於 A 股市場的總體情緒，仍需防範潛在的破發壓力與業績兌現風險。

重點摘要
- Step App 宣布關閉，服務 8 月 21 日前結束，累計下載超過 100 萬次
- 其代幣 FITFI 從 2022 年高點 0.73 美元跌到 0.00016 美元，跌幅 99.98%
- 始祖 STEPN 仍在營運，今年 1 月才完成 GMT 減半，姊妹 App 持續更新
跑步鏈遊 Step App 宣布收攤。官方在寫給社群的信裡說，經營四年之後決定關閉，所有服務會在 8 月 21 日前逐步結束，並且提醒使用者在那之前解除鎖倉的代幣、處理好交易所的部位。官方列出的最後成績是累計超過 100 萬次下載、追蹤了數十億步。
Dear Steppers,
There's no easy way to say this — after four years of work, Step App is shutting down. We've been sitting with this decision for a while, and it's time to be straight with you.
We are incredibly proud of what Step App achieved — not just as a product, but as a… pic.twitter.com/pswBrywfyS
— Step App | The Future of Fitness (@StepApp_) August 5, 2026
四年前這個賽道有多熱
Move to Earn 在 2022 年春天是整個加密圈最吵的敘事。始祖 STEPN 靠著一雙 NFT 跑鞋，把跑步變成挖礦，同期跟進的專案一大票，Step App 是其中聲量最大的幾個之一。
當時的數字現在看起來很不真實，據 TechCrunch 報導，STEPN 在 2022 年 5 月的月收入達到 1 億美元，光是使用者交易手續費，每天就能帶進 300 萬到 500 萬美元的淨利。月活躍使用者高峰超過 70 萬人，日活躍使用者曾經在 2022 年 6 月 2 日衝上 100 萬。
幣價更誇張，根據 CoinGecko 資料，這三個代幣的高點與現況是這樣：
- GST（STEPN 的消耗型代幣）: 2022 年 4 月 28 日高點 8.51 美元，現價 0.00095 美元，跌幅 99.99%
- GMT（STEPN 治理代幣）: 2022 年 4 月 27 日高點 4.11 美元，現價 0.0068 美元，跌幅 99.84%
- FITFI（Step App 代幣）: 2022 年 5 月 5 日高點 0.73 美元，現價 0.00016 美元，跌幅 99.98%
三個代幣，三個不同的專案，跌幅整整齊齊落在 99.8% 到 99.99% 之間。
始祖還在跑
有意思的是，這波熱潮的起點 STEPN 反而活下來了。它今年 1 月 1 日才完成 GMT 減半，把使用者同樣運動量的獎勵砍半，姊妹 App STEPN GO 也還在更新，近期還做了世界盃活動與空投。代價是規模大幅縮水，GMT 的 24 小時交易量從高峰約 3.6 億美元掉到現在的數百萬美元等級，月活躍使用者也從 70 萬掉到數萬人。
整個賽道的狀況大家也能感受到，Web3 遊戲項目們燒掉大約 150 億美元之後，大約 93% 的專案已經名存實亡，代幣價值自 2022 年高點平均下跌 95%。Step App 和 STEPN 只是名單上比較有名的項目。
常見問題
Step App 什麼時候正式關閉？
官方公告所有服務將在 2026 年 8 月 21 日前逐步結束，使用者應在此之前解除鎖倉的代幣並處理交易所部位。該專案經營四年，累計下載超過 100 萬次。
STEPN 也一起關掉了嗎？
沒有。STEPN 仍在營運，2026 年 1 月 1 日完成 GMT 減半，姊妹 App STEPN GO 持續更新。但規模大幅縮水，月活躍使用者從高峰逾 70 萬掉到數萬人。

title: SpaceX 今日迎 9 億股巨額解鎖！規模達流通股 140%，年底前還有 40 億股湧入市場
summary:
太空探索巨頭 SpaceX 的投資人請注意！據知名財經帳號 Walter Bloomberg 於 X 平台發布 […]

〈SpaceX 今日迎 9 億股巨額解鎖！規模達流通股 140%，年底前還有 40 億股湧入市場〉這篇文章最早發佈於動區BlockTempo《動區動趨-最具影響力的區塊鏈新聞媒體》。
full_text:
太空探索巨頭 SpaceX 的投資人請注意！據知名財經帳號 Walter Bloomberg 於 X 平台發布的最新消息指出，SpaceX（$SPCX）今日將面臨高達 9.115 億股的巨額解鎖，規模超過目前公開流通股的 140%。這波龐大的籌碼釋放預計將大幅增加短期股價的波動風險，且至年底前累計將有超過 40 億股具備交易資格。
（前情提要：SpaceX 估值上看 10 兆美元！早期投資人 Peter Diamandis：永遠別賭馬斯克會失敗）
（背景補充：SpaceX 盤前下跌 8%，關鍵在單季資本支出）
隨著財報季的餘波盪漾，由馬斯克（Elon Musk）領軍的太空探索技術公司 SpaceX（$SPCX）正迎來一場嚴峻的籌碼面考驗。台北時間 8 月 6 日，據深具影響力的財經資訊帳號 Walter Bloomberg 披露，SpaceX 於今日正式面臨大規模的股票解鎖（Share unlock）。數據顯示，高達 9.115 億股的 SpaceX 股份將於今日解禁並流入市場，這批數量驚人的籌碼相當於目前公開流通股（Public float）的 140% 以上，引發市場對於短期股價劇烈波動的高度擔憂。
$SPCX – SPACEX FACES MASSIVE SHARE UNLOCK
Up to 911.5M SpaceX shares unlock today—more than 140% of the current public float—raising the risk of near-term volatility.
The stock fell 12% after earnings despite beating on revenue and posting an unexpected AI profit.
More…
— *Walter Bloomberg (@DeItaone) August 6, 2026
財報擊敗預期並獲 AI 利潤，股價仍難敵賣壓重挫 12%
回顧 SpaceX 近期的市場表現，該公司在最新發布的財報中其實交出了相當亮眼的成績單。財報數據不僅顯示其營收成功擊敗了華爾街的市場預期，SpaceX 甚至還意外地公布了其在人工智慧（AI）相關領域取得了實質獲利。
然而，如此強勁的基本面利多，卻未能如預期般提振股價。截至發稿時，SpaceX 股價在財報發布後反而重挫了 12%。市場分析指出，這正是因為投資人早已將目光轉向即將到來的巨量籌碼解鎖，潛在的拋售賣壓成為了壓抑股價表現的關鍵元兇。
解鎖潮接踵而至，年底前逾 40 億股成未爆彈
更令市場戒慎恐懼的是，今日的 9.115 億股解鎖僅是這波籌碼釋放的開端。根據 Walter Bloomberg 揭露的時程表，SpaceX 緊接著在 8 月 12 日將迎來下一波股票解鎖，並在隨後的 20 天後釋出另一批股份。
預計到 2026 年年底前，將有累計超過 40 億股的 SpaceX 股份具備交易資格。這種接連不斷且規模龐大的籌碼供應預期，將在市場上形成極大的潛在賣壓（Overhang）。儘管多數市場投資人依然高度認可並關注 SpaceX 在太空基礎設施與 AI 領域的長期基本面，但短線上的籌碼結構失衡，無疑已成為該公司股價在未來幾個月內必須克服的最大逆風。

title: Agent 終於能自己花錢了，Cloudflare 錢包引爆註冊熱潮
summary:
Cloudflare 推出 AI Agent 專用錢包 Cloudflare Wallets，支援 USDC 穩定幣小額支付與可程式化消費規則，並同步開放 cloudflare.pay 身分註冊，引爆註冊熱潮，也讓 AI Agent 支付、鏈上身分正式邁向主流。

〈Agent 終於能自己花錢了，Cloudflare 錢包引爆註冊熱潮〉這篇文章最早發佈於《區塊客》。
full_text:
作者：Nancy，PANews
8 月 5 日，社群媒體刮起了一陣橘色旋風，不少部落客在 X 上曬出了自己橘色的錢包 ID 。原來是「賽博活佛」Cloudflare 在 8 月 4 日晚間推出 AI Agent 的可程式錢包 Cloudflare Wallets，不僅讓 Agent 具備自主參與網路交易的能力，也讓加密基礎設施概念進一步走向大眾。
同時，Cloudflare 開放 cloudflare.pay Wallet 名稱註冊，也引發了一場意外的 Agent 身分搶注熱潮。
面向 Agent 的可編程錢包，支援穩定幣小額支付
Cloudflare 最新發布的部落格宣布，將推出針對 AI Agent 的可程式錢包 Cloudflare Wallets，旨在幫助 AI Agent 自主完成 API 購買、內容消費以及服務交易。
事實上，隨著 AI Agent 逐漸從輔助工具走向自主執行任務，一個新的問題開始出現：如果一個 AI 需要購買 API 、呼叫資料服務或消費數位內容，它該如何完成付款？
目前，大多數網路服務仍圍繞著人類使用者設計。 AI Agent 通常需要先註冊帳戶、綁定付款方式、申請 API 金鑰，甚至經過人工確認後才能使用服務。這套流程不僅增加了接取成本，也限制了 Agent 自主探索、比較和呼叫不同服務的能力。
Cloudflare Wallets 試圖解決 AI Agent 在網路時代缺少的支付、身分和權限管理問題。
此錢包主要分為帳戶錢包和虛擬錢包。其中，帳戶錢包主要面向個人或企業用戶，用於儲值資金、管理資產，並向 AI Agent 授權消費額度；虛擬錢包專為 AI Agent 設計，能夠代表用戶完成購買作業。
虛擬錢包是市場最為關注的。為了降低自動支付帶來的風險，用戶可提前為虛擬錢包設定消費規則，包括單筆交易額度、白名單及單筆支付上限等。這樣一來，使用者無需在每一次操作中手動確認，而是透過規則授權 Agent 自主執行任務，同時將資金風險控制在可接受範圍內。
這項設計讓 Agent 在探索網路服務時獲得了更大的行動空間。由於消費額度通常被限制在較小範圍內，用戶可以放心讓 Agent 嘗試大量 API 和工具，而不必擔心因錯誤呼叫或惡意服務造成較大損失。
支撐 Cloudflare Wallets 小額支付能力的關鍵技術之一，是基於 Coinbase 推出的開源支付協議 x402 。該協議透過穩定幣 USDC 實現機器之間的小額支付，讓 AI Agent 無需註冊傳統帳戶或綁定銀行卡，即可直接存取並購買 API 服務，大幅降低了測試和呼叫新服務的成本。目前，x402 已支援 Base 、 Polygon 、 Arbitrum 、 World 和 Solana 等多個區塊鏈網絡，其基金會已獲得 Visa 、萬事達卡、美國運通、 Stripe 、 Google 、 AWS 以及 Cloudflare 等機構支持。
Agent 有了「身分證」後，意外掀起搶注潮
除了支付能力，Cloudflare 也試圖解決 AI Agent 在網路中的身分問題。
在傳統網路中，網站和服務商通常依賴帳戶體系來識別使用者身分。但隨著 AI Agent 開始自主存取網站、呼叫 API 甚至完成交易，服務商很難判斷背後究竟是真實使用者、企業組織，還是潛在的惡意操作者。
例如，一家公司可以輕鬆向真實用戶提供免費試用或優惠服務，但面對缺乏穩定身分的 AI Agent 時，往往難以判斷其需求是否真實。同一用戶可能創建大量 Agent，導致服務商無法有效區分正常需求與批量濫用。
為解決這個問題，Cloudflare 推出了 cloudflare.pay，相當於 Agent 的電子身分證，並將其與 Cloudflare 帳戶體系綁定，使 Agent 擁有可識別、可追蹤的數位身分。
不過，Agent 是否公開自己的身份，並非強制要求，而是由使用者自主決定。同時，企業也可以根據自身需求，選擇是否優先服務擁有認證身分的 Agent 。
隨著 cloudflare.pay 的錢包名稱預約正式開放，並採用先到先得的規則，迅速掀起了一波搶注 ID 的熱潮。
除了 Cloudflare CEO Matthew Prince 公開曬自己的 Handle 外，大量用戶也紛紛在社群媒體紛紛展現搶注結果。名人、熱門品牌和頭部 AI 公司等相關名稱都快速搶注，場面頗有當年 Web3 網域被熱炒的既視感。甚至有用戶特別建置了查詢網站，方便大家尋找尚未註冊的熱門 Handle 。
多年前，Web3 也刮起了一場鏈上域名淘金熱，彼時用戶爭相搶注域名，不少熱門名稱甚至被高價炒作。眼下，類似的認同爭奪正在 AI 時代重新上演。
對於參與者而言，有人希望提前鎖定身份，為未來 AI Agent 支付場景佈局；也有人抱著投資心態，將 Handle 視為具備潛在價值的數位資產。
這場 Handle 搶注熱潮，不僅進一步提升了 Cloudflare Wallets 的市場關注度，也讓錢包、穩定幣支付和鏈上身份這些過去主要存在於加密圈內的概念，首次觸達更多普通網路用戶。
更重要的是，Cloudflare 本身的產業影響力，為這些加密原生概念進入主流市場提供了更容易觸及、更可信的入口。
身為全球網路基礎設施服務巨頭，Cloudflare 是目前全球使用最廣的 CDN（內容傳遞網路）服務商之一。過去，Cloudflare 曾一度因服務中斷，導致眾多知名網站和服務無法訪問，引發全球網路大面積癱瘓，也從側面反映出市場對其在網路中的重要地位。同時，Cloudflare 長期也累積了市場信賴，Cloudflare 長期向開發者和一般用戶提供大量免費基礎設施服務，讓原本只有大型企業才能承擔的全球加速、安全防護能力變得更加普及，還被稱為「賽博活佛」。
相較於加密原生公司，Cloudflare 這種擁有龐大用戶基礎和基礎設施影響力的 Web2 巨頭入場，或許更容易推動加密概念走向大眾，並推動加密基礎設施逐漸走向主流網絡。
錢包只是開始，欲搭建 AI 時代的「無頭市場」
Cloudflare 真正想建構的，不只一個錢包，而是一套以 AI 時代為導向的「無頭市場」（Headless Marketplace）。
所謂無頭市場，是指未來交易不再依賴傳統網頁介面、人工點擊以及複雜註冊流程，而是由 AI Agent 自主完成服務發現、需求匹配、價格比較、支付結算和資源取得。
在這個模式下，AI Agent 不再只是執行人類指令的工具，而可能成為網路中的主動參與者。它們能夠根據任務需求尋找服務、呼叫工具，並在授權的範圍內完成交易。
這也是 Cloudflare 建構 Agentic Internet 商業生態的核心願景，讓支付和交易成為網路的原生能力，而不是依賴手動操作的額外環節。
先前，Cloudflare 已圍繞 AI 基礎設施持續佈局，先後推出 Workers AI 、 Agents SDK 、 AI Crawl Control 、 Monetization Gateway 等產品，涵蓋 AI 推理、 Agent 開發運作、內容存取管理以及資源變現等多個環節。 Wallets 的推出，則補齊了 Cloudflare 搭建無頭市場中最關鍵的支付一環。
未來，AI Agent 或將不再只是執行指令的工具，也可能像真實使用者一樣擁有身分、預算和交易能力，成為網路經濟中的新型參與者。但正如 Cloudflare 所提到的，網路不會一夜轉向 Agent 經濟，但圍繞著身分認同、支付和基礎建設的佈局，或許正是 Agent 商業生態走向落地的第一步。
（以上內容獲合作夥伴 PANews 授權節錄及轉載，原文連結 ）

title: AI 投資「中場休息」：算力股不吃香了，下半場盯緊「這 2 件事」
summary:
AI 股反彈背後，華爾街已開始布局下一波行情。摩根士丹利、高盛認為，AI 投資將由晶片轉向商業化應用與 HALO 硬資產，能源、電網、基建與關鍵原料可望成為下一輪市場焦點。

〈AI 投資「中場休息」：算力股不吃香了，下半場盯緊「這 2 件事」〉這篇文章最早發佈於《區塊客》。
full_text:
作者：Jae，PANews
8 月第一周，美股 AI 產業鏈上的主流標的普遍收獲了 10% 以上的可觀漲幅。輝達股價連續 5 日上漲，邁威爾更是斬獲了接近 20% 的漲幅。在 7 月經歷了「滑鐵盧」的 AI 產業鏈概念股到了新的一個月終於揚眉吐氣，收復了大片失地。
不過，這波迅猛漲勢其實離不開 7 月下旬激烈的槓桿清洗。彼時，半導體和算力上游標的都遭遇了顯著的估值回撤，市場上空一度瀰漫著「泡沫破裂」的恐慌。摩根士丹利中國首席經濟學家刑自強的最新研判指出：AI 賽道在近期的波動並非基本面惡化，而是交易擁擠、大廠融資抽水、油價推升加息預期共振所致的階段性「半場休整」。這一觀點也成為華爾街各大投行的共識。
目前，雖然美股 AI 產業鏈標的依然有高光錶現，但 AI 板塊的狂熱情緒無疑地逐漸退燒，全球資本市場最熾熱的引擎也正在悄悄換檔。在 AI 投資的上半場，資本扎堆押注算力晶片，追捧「賣鏟人」的確定性故事；摩根士丹利研究團隊認為，下半場的投資重心或將沿著兩條路線遷移：一條向應用端下沉，追逐真實的降本增效與現金流兌現；另一條則向物理世界延伸，重估能源、資產等 AI 。
「三座大山」壓垮 AI「賣鏟人」
三股力量的疊加，共同按下了 AI 賽道的「暫停鍵」。
擁擠交易：高槓桿籌碼堆出的脆弱平衡
上半年的 AI 行情，是一份「擁擠交易」的典型樣本。
大量槓桿資金與追漲資金衝進算力晶片、半導體、儲存等上游賽道，導致籌碼集中度迅速攀升至歷史高點。擁擠的籌碼結構放大了盤面的脆弱性，從而引發了踩踏式的去槓桿拋售。
7 月下旬，過於一致的交易預期迎來了一次集中的籌碼鬆動。根據高盛統計，槓桿半導體 ETF 的資產管理規模（AUM）從 6 月高峰的約 1,630 億美元下滑至 1,000 億美元，跌幅近 40%，創下 2025 年 4 月以來的最大降幅。在同期美國所有槓桿 ETF 的資金流出中，半導體 ETF 佔比約 63% 。
不過，去槓桿也有效清除了純粹概念炒作的泡沫，讓市場在 AI 賽道上的過熱情緒降溫。
資金抽水：千億美元資本支出的流動性反噬
AI 軍備競賽的另一面，是對二級市場流動性的持續消耗。
全球超大規模雲端服務商為了搶佔算力高地，計畫在 AI 基礎設施上投入數千億美元，但它們的現金流難以完全覆蓋如此龐大的資本開支缺口。因此，科技大廠頻繁透過股票增發、發行大額企業債等方式對外大規模融資。根據《金融時報》披露，四大矽谷巨頭截至今年第二季的 AI 累計資本投入已高達 1.1 兆美元。摩根大通研究團隊也指出，AI 相關債務已占美國投資等級債券市場的 15% 以上，成為最大的單一債務板塊，如果下游變現不如預期，過度舉債將對企業的信用評等構成潛在威脅。
二級市場被不斷「抽水」，資金供給收緊，估值自然承壓。簡單來說，算力擴張越激進，對流動性的虹吸效應越強。
利率陰雲：通膨反彈的估價擠壓
宏觀層面的變數成為了壓垮高估值的最後一根稻草。
中東地緣衝突升溫推高了國際油價，市場對通膨黏性反彈的擔憂捲土重來，倒逼聯準會升息預期抬頭。無風險利率的上行提高了未來現金流的折現率。對於尚在投入期、現金流量仍未兌現的 AI 標的而言，折現率的抬升進一步壓制了它們的估值。
在三重壓力下，「賣鏟子」的生意突然變得不好做了。
AI 投資邏輯變換車道：一手算 ROI，一手搶硬資產
高盛與摩根士丹利指出，基礎模型訓練正向大規模推理部署過渡，單純堆疊算力、比拼參數的故事開始邊際失效。資本市場的估值錨點，也轉向商業模式的兌現能力與物理世界的資源瓶頸。
AI 應用端：從說故事到算 ROI
AI 投資的下半場，是一場財務兌現能力的淘汰賽。
上半場，標的只要沾滿 AI 概念就能享有估價溢價；下半場，參數規模不再是主要指標，投入產出比才是獲得高估值的依據。市場將更關注企業能否用 AI 實現降本增效、轉化為營收與現金流的成長。
隨著推理成本持續下行，那些具備強閉環生態、獨家數據資產與高客戶黏性的應用型企業將脫穎而出。例如，把 AI 嵌入遊戲開發、廣告投放或數位化業務流程的企業，能更顯著地壓低單位營運成本，將 AI 技術轉化為內生效率引擎和產品議價能力。
資本向 ROI 靠攏，會倒逼 AI 廠商從「拼參數」轉向「拼落地」，加速 AI 從實驗室走向真實產業。目前在 AI 應用端，除了 Palantir(PLTR) 等少數領先玩家已實現財務成長，其它標的依然需要後續的市場數據來說話。
HALO 資產：AI 的盡頭是物理世界
「AI 的盡頭是能源和原材料」，高盛上個月的一句判斷正在變成市場共識。
HALO（Heavy Assets，Low Obsolescence，即重資產、低淘汰）資產指的是那些具備高障礙有形資本且難以被技術快速替代的實體資產，例如：銅礦、電力電網、基建設備、核能資源等。這類 AI「搬不走、拆不掉、造不出」的實體硬資產或將受到全球資金的追捧。
高盛在《The HALO Effect》報告中指出，全球市場正在經歷「稀缺性的重新定價」。過去十年市場追捧「輕資產輕、高擴張」的軟體模式，但 AI 降低了資訊處理門檻，大幅壓縮了軟體與 IT 服務企業的估值和利潤率上限。相反，實體資產的重置成本因通膨和供應鏈再區域化而大幅上升。
簡單來說，大模型在以周為單位迭代，演算法與軟體服務的門檻被大幅抹平，部分依賴簡單程式碼或中介服務的輕資產 SaaS 企業正面臨著被 AI Agent（智能體）取代的顛覆性風險。演算法能被開源模型超越，軟體能被 AI Agent 重寫，但電網不能被隨意複製，銅礦不能憑空生成，核電站也不能在一夜之間建成。
依照華爾街機構的分類標準，HALO 主題涵蓋了電力與核能、電網與基建、關鍵原料、工程製造四大主要板塊，每一個都是 AI 算力擴張難以繞過的物理關卡，其中也不乏貝萊德、高盛等機構具有高共識的潛力標的。
在電力與核能領域，以 Constellation Energy（CEG）、 Vistra Corp（VST）與 NextEra Energy（NEE）為代表的獨立核電巨頭，正成為資本的焦點。在公共電網擴容受限的背景下，它們憑藉著牌照優勢和「機組旁建機房」（Behind-the-meter）的直連供電模式，核電廠成為數據中心的主力能源供應商，吸引科技巨頭們簽下為期多年、附帶保底價格的購電協議（PPA），把原本高確定性的公用業務轉化為高確定性的資產。
在電網與基建領域，高功耗 GPU 的普及導致傳統風冷散熱達到了物理極限，資料中心向液冷技術的轉型是大勢所趨。 Vertiv（VRT）依靠在精密冷卻與熱管理技術上的領先地位，將吃到機房散熱升級的紅利。 Eaton（ETN）和 Quanta Services（PWR）則掌控配電設備、變壓器與高壓電網的施工能力，決定了電網擴容的實際速度。另外，實體電網升級的長週期工程也為它們築起了較高的競爭障礙。
在關鍵原料領域，Freeport-McMoRan（FCX）手握優質的特大銅礦資源及開採權。無論是電力傳輸、變壓器繞組或資料中心內部佈線，銅都是不可取代的物理傳導介質。而礦山開發週期長、礦石品質下滑等問題大幅降低了新銅礦的供給彈性，供需缺口的長期放大將持續推高銅礦資源的定價權。
在工程製造領域，Caterpillar（CAT）和 Deere&Co (DE) 有著龐大的實體工廠、專有工程技術和全球供應鍊網絡，建構了難以被程式碼或演算法取代的物理壁壘，在基建大潮中持續取得訂單。
在 AI 投資的下半場，Eaton 的變壓器、 Caterpillar 的巨型挖土機、 Newmont 的銅礦等曾被視為「老經濟」的資產，突然被賦予了新的戰略價值。資本對 HALO 資產的重定價，將為下一階段更龐大的 AI 基建需求築牢物理底座。
然而，HALO 資產的建設週期長、資金投入大。一旦下游 AI 應用的商業化兌現速度不如預期，前置投放的能源與算力基建也可能引發產能過剩、資產沉沒的風險。
「半場休息」是資本市場走向理性分化的必要階段，未來的超額收益將一頭伸向真實的商業場景，一頭扎進堅實的硬資產。只有兼具商業化造血能力與物理護城河的玩家，才能在「半場休息」後的長跑中保持領先。

title: Burnham orders review of grooming gang early releases
summary: The announcement of the review comes after the Tory leader raised concerns that child sex offenders could leave jail early.
full_text:
Burnham orders review of grooming gang early releases
- Published
Prime Minister Andy Burnham has ordered an urgent review of grooming gang cases involving offenders that may be eligible to be freed from jail early under the government's release scheme.
The announcement of the review comes after Tory leader Kemi Badenoch raised concerns that child sex offenders could leave jail well before the end of their sentences.
She pointed out that indecent assault was not included in the list of offences that the government said would be excluded, external from the early release scheme.
Five men convicted of indecent assault as part of a historical grooming-gang case in Bradford are among the prisoners whose offences were not included in the list of exclusions.
The prime minister's spokesperson said Burnham had asked the Ministry of Justice (MoJ) to "conduct an in-depth review of cases to ensure that grooming cases were identified".
"This work is happening urgently," Burnham's spokesperson said.
"This is extremely important to the PM and he has personally intervened to ensure everything possible is being done so that vile groomers are dealt with in the way their victims deserve."
It is understood that at this stage the review will only seek to identify offenders who might be released early.
The government has not confirmed whether the review will lead to the prevention of any early releases of offenders convicted of grooming-related crimes.
Badenoch described the intervention as "another U-turn secured" and "another review from Burnham following my letter".
The government is planning to release about 5,000 offenders in England and Wales early in an effort to make space in overcrowded jails.
Burnham launched a review of the scheme after he became prime minister and this week he announced that some prisoners convicted of rape, serious child sex and other grooming offences would barred from early release.
But in a letter, external, Badenoch said many more types of offenders - including those convicted of sexually assaulting children - could be freed early.
"On Tuesday, you told the country that those convicted of grooming offences would be excluded," she wrote. "Your own government has now put in writing that some of these men will be released early anyway."
Highlighting that indecent assault was not excluded from the early release scheme, Badenoch said "many cases of child sex abuse committed before 2004 were charged this way, including Rotherham and Rochdale".
Badenoch branded this a "betrayal of victims", and urged Burnham to publish the full list of offences that remain eligible for early release.
Under changes made by Burnham, external, people sentenced for rape, serious child sex and grooming offences will now not be eligible for early release from October.
But some prisoners who are not excluded could be freed after serving a third of their total custodial sentence rather than after 40% or 50% of their term.
Burnham said he had wanted to exclude more offenders, but prison overcrowding prevented this.
The prime minister said making more prisoners exempt was not possible without the prison system collapsing and putting the public "at much greater risk".
The prison population in England and Wales on 3 August was 86,495, which was 97% of useable capacity.
The number of places in jails in England and Wales has not kept pace with the significant rise in the prison population in recent decades under successive governments.
There are cases of offenders who were convicted of indecent assault under section 14 and 15 of the Sexual Offences Act 1956.
These sections of the 1956 Act were not included in the government's list of exclusions, suggesting prisoners convicted of these crimes could qualify for the early release scheme.
Five men who were jailed in October 2005, external, after being convicted of indecent assault for abusing a teenage girl in Bradford in the early 2000s, could be eligible for early release under the scheme.
In December 2024, Ajaz Karim was jailed for 21 months after he was convicted of indecent assault for sexually abusing a 13-year-old girl at the school where he was a sports coach.
In another case, Shahid Hussain was jailed for eight years in September 2024, after he was convicted of indecently assaulting a 14-year-old girl in Rotherham in 2003.
The government has not yet confirmed exactly which offenders will be released.
The mother of PC Andrew Harper also said she was "devastated" to learn two men jailed after her son was killed will still be eligible for early release.
PC Harper, 28, was killed in 2019 when he was dragged by a car down a country road as three teenagers fled the scene of a quad bike theft in Berkshire.
His family previously said they had received a letter from the Ministry of Justice confirming that two of the offenders could be included in the early release scheme.
Earlier this week, Justice Secretary Alex Norris apologised to families affected by the early release scheme, saying they were "carrying the can from previous failures".
The justice secretary said about 5,000 extra releases will take place in 10 batches from October - down from about 6,000 before the revision.
The changes are due to be phased in, beginning with prisoners serving sentences of fewer than 575 days, going up to inmates jailed for 12 years or more being eligible for early release in June 2027.
The number of individuals released each time will depend on the prison population, which the government says will evolve between now and implementation.

title: Calls for inquiry into Army training college for teenagers after reports of rape and abuse
summary: Four women told the BBC they were sexually assaulted and harassed while attending the Army Foundation College (AFC) at Harrogate in North Yorkshire.
full_text:
Calls for inquiry into Army teen college after reports of rape and abuse
- Published
Warning: This article contains sexual language and details of sexual assault
Calls are growing for an independent inquiry into an Army training college for teenagers following allegations of rape and sexual abuse against female recruits.
Four young women told the BBC they were sexually assaulted and harassed while attending the Army Foundation College (AFC) at Harrogate in North Yorkshire.
They described a culture of misogyny and sexual violence at the college, which they all attended when they were 17.
Sarah Atherton, former MP for Wrexham, told the BBC that public confidence in the college could "only be restored through an independent inquiry".
Emma Lewell MP said: "If this was any other school or residential environment for children, it would have been closed down."
- Women tell BBC of rape and abuse at Army teen college 
  - Published9 hours ago
Atherton, who previously served in the Army's Intelligence Corps, led a 2021 government review into the experiences of women in the armed forces.
The review, which took evidence from over 4,200 women, reported cases of rape, sexual exploitation of under 18s, and women being drugged before being assaulted.
It concluded that women were being "denied justice" by a "woefully inadequate" military complaints process.
Speaking to the BBC on Thursday, Atherton said: "Concerns at AFC Harrogate were raised years ago, and subsequent data and complaints suggest the problems continued without adequate action".
An independent inquiry, she said, was "the best way to establish the facts, restore public confidence and ensure the Army can recruit and retain the talented young people it needs".
"Parents, staff and recruits deserve clear answers, accountability where necessary, and confidence that every possible lesson has been learned," she added.
Lewell, who sits on the Defence Committee, said: "I think as a matter of urgency there should be an independent inquiry into the college led by someone with significant safeguarding experience, and they need to be able to speak to the children there.
"There's been an ongoing complaints for a long time now around sexual assault, bullying, sexual abuse and physical abuse so it's a matter of urgency."
The Army said "unacceptable and criminal behaviour has absolutely no place in our Armed Forces" as it called for victims and witnesses of criminal behaviour at the college to come forward.
It said several reforms had been introduced to support victims, including the Defence Serious Crime Command providing specialist support through the justice process - outside of the Army chain of command.
AFC is the largest military training establishment for under-19s in the UK and it receives all the Army's 16-year-old recruits.
North Yorkshire Police told the BBC in a response to a Freedom of Information Act request it had received 16 reports of sexual offences linked to the college in the year to June, including allegations of exposure, voyeurism and sexual assault.
No information was included on whether the reports had led to prosecutions.
A total of 176 complaints of inappropriate sexual behaviour at the college were made between January 2018 and June 2025, according to Ministry of Defence (MoD) data.
The women, whose names have been changed to protect their identities, all attended AFC over the last five years.
One woman, Tilly, told the BBC she was 17 when she was raped at AFC by several fellow soldiers who invited her into their room.
"They started taking my clothes off and then this led to them doing stuff I didn't consent to.
"And then I was raped… by multiple junior soldiers, same age as me. It went on for hours. I felt like a piece of meat."
Another woman's story was shared with the BBC by her mother, who said her daughter Amy was sexually assaulted and subjected to almost daily sexual harassment during her training.
Because the lock to Amy's room was not working, her mother said "she found herself sleeping across the door to stop male soldiers coming in".
Another woman, who said she was sexually assaulted and harassed at AFC, described how misogynistic attitudes and behaviour of AFC staff rubbed off on some of the male teenagers.
She recalled one of the instructors saying: "It's all about the pussy and how much of it you can get."
The Army told the BBC a visit to AFC by the Children's Commissioner and safeguarding authorities in January 2026 had recognised "the culture of care and the confidence junior soldiers have in raising concerns".
It added that the college's "robust discipline system" has been graded "outstanding" by the schools' inspectorate, Ofsted, which visits the college every three years.
Ashleigh Percival-Borley, a veteran who served for 13 years in the British Army as a sergeant and multi-disciplinary instructor, said "incidents like this have "really taken my confidence out of the institution and that makes me really sad".
She told Radio 4's Today programme there was a "level of frustration" from women who wanted to serve in the army.
She said hearing the allegations "sickened" her as a female veteran as well as a former instructor who knew "the embodiment of the army's values and standards" needed for the role.
An MoD report last year found that 67% of women in the armed forces had experienced at least one sexualised behaviour in the previous 12 months, compared to 34% of men.
Last year, an ex-army sergeant major was jailed for six months for sexually assaulting a 19-year-old soldier, who later took her own life.
Warrant Officer Michael Webber, 43, pinned down Royal Artillery Gunner Jaysley Beck and tried to kiss her in July 2021. She was found dead five months later in her barracks at Larkhill, Wiltshire.
The inquest into her death ruled the sexual assault and the Army's failure to take appropriate action "more than minimally" contributed to her taking her life.
Jaysley's mother, Leighann McCready, told BBC Breakfast Jaysley was 19 when she reported what happened to her chain of command, but she was "disbelieved" and branded "a female trouble maker".
"This is the problem that soldiers are facing - what they are going to be branded afterwards," her mother said.
"If a junior solider can follow their policies and procedures then those above should do exactly the same. Had they had done, I believe our daughter would have still been alive", she added.
AFC remains committed to creating a professional, supportive, and safe environment for all recruits, the Army said.
It added: "Any suggestion otherwise contradicts the values of respect and inclusivity that we stand for."
If you have more information about this story, you can reach Sima by email at Sima.Kotecha@bbc.co.uk

title: Ukraine hits two oil refineries deep in Russian territory
summary: Ukraine's president says the strikes aim to limit revenues Russia "used to finance" its war.
full_text:
Ukraine hits two oil refineries deep in Russian territory
- Published
Ukraine said it has hit two oil refineries in multiple strikes deep inside Russia with patrol boats and other vessels in the Black Sea also hit.
President Volodymyr Zelensky said the Bashneft-Novoil and Slavneft-Yanos refineries were struck in the attacks aimed at limiting oil revenues Moscow "uses to finance" its war.
Yaroslavl regional governor Mikhail Evraev said Slavneft-Yanos was on fire after what he called the "largest enemy drone attack". He said four people were injured.
Meanwhile, Ukraine said at least 11 people were killed in Russian attacks, and the southern city of Kherson reported a total blackout. Russia said it targeted fuel, energy and transport facilities.
- In Odesa, no-one is safe from Russia's new Black Sea strikes 
  - Published9 hours ago
- After deadly Kyiv strike, Ukraine warns interceptor shortage is costing lives 
  - Published20 hours ago
Both Russia and Ukraine have in recent weeks intensified attacks on major cities, energy facilities and warehouses, as the vast front line remains virtually static and all mediation efforts to end the war have brought no breakthrough.
Russian President Vladimir Putin launched a full-scale invasion of Ukraine in February 2022.
Zelensky said on Thursday that the struck Bashneft-Novoil refinery in Russia's Bashkortostan republic was about 1,300km (808 miles) from the Ukrainian border, whereas Slavneft-Yanos was almost 700km (435 miles) away.
The Ukrainian president also said that "two military patrol boats and shadow fleet vessels were hit" in the Black Sea, referring to tankers used by Russia to illegally export sanctioned oil.
"Russia must choose peace," Zelensky said, adding that Ukrainian attacks were "strengthening chances for diplomacy".
Evraev said 93 drones were shot down over Yaroslavl region overnight.
"Falling debris hit the oil refinery's storage tanks. Emergency services are working to extinguish the fire," he said.
BBC Verify confirmed multiple videos and images shared on social media showing huge smoke plumes rising from the refinery.
In one of the verified images there appear to be at least four fires at the site.
Energy-generating infrastructure in Yaroslavl has been targeted a number of times by Ukraine.
The authorities in Bashkortostan have not publicly commented on the reported Ukrainian attack on the Bashneft-Novoil refinery on 5 August.
In Ukraine, three people were killed in the town of Balakliya, Kharkiv region, in an overnight Russian drone attack, the country's state emergencies service DSNS said.
It said private residential houses were targeted, with fires reported in two buildings.
Kharkiv regional head Oleh Synehubov later said that another two people were killed when drones attacked the train station in Lozova. Another eight people were injured.
Later on Thursday, five people were killed in Russian strikes on the central Dnipropetrovsk region, local officials said.
In the south, the entire city of Kherson is now without electricity after a "critical infrastructure facility" was hit overnight, regional head Oleksandr Prokudin said.
In Ukraine's Black Sea port of Odesa, one person was killed when Russia hit two dry cargo ships.
Meanwhile, the Russian military said its forces intercepted or shot down 605 Ukrainian drones overnight over a number of regions.
In its latest operational update, the military said it struck Ukraine's fuel, energy and transport facilities, as well as drone storage sites.

title: US Senate committee votes to hold Fauci in contempt over Covid hearing
summary: The committee will now refer him for potential prosecution following his refusal to answer questions during a hearing focused on his handling of the Covid-19 pandemic.
full_text:
US Senate committee votes to hold Fauci in contempt over Covid hearing
- Published
A US Senate committee has voted to hold former top health official Anthony Fauci in contempt of Congress after he refused to answer questions during a hearing examining his handling of the Covid-19 pandemic.
The vote - which fell along party lines - means that the committee will refer the case to the justice department for potential prosecution for failing to comply with a congressional subpoena.
It remains unclear whether the department will pursue the case.
During his testimony last week, Fauci invoked his constitutional right against self-incrimination more than 100 times during his testimony last week, arguing that Kentucky Senator Rand Paul was trying to put him "behind bars".
The origins of the pandemic have been a matter of strong debate in the US, including between President Donald Trump, who was in office when it began in 2020, and public health officials, including Fauci.
Seantor Rand Paul has for years accused Fauci of attempting to hide its origins and of funding a research lab in the Chinese city of Wuhan, where some believe the pandemic began with a lab-leak.
Most scientists believe that exposure to an infected animal is a more likely origin for the pandemic.
Former President Joe Biden gave Fauci a pre-emptive pardon on his last day in office in 2025, protecting him from federal prosecution for his actions between 2014 and 2025.
But Fauci could still face charges for anything after that date, including contempt of Congress. He could also face state or local charges that are not covered by the pardon.
"The chair directed Anthony Fauci to answer. He refused," Kentucky Republican Rand Paul said ahead of the vote. "That is what we are voting on today — not his opinions, not his policies, not anything he said from the podium six years ago. "
"We are voting on whether a witness who has received the benefit of a federal pardon can be ordered by this committee to answer questions and then defy that order without consequence," he added.
Fauci has repeatedly denied any wrongdoing, and last week accused Paul of having an "obvious obsession" with prosecuting him.
"The only conclusion I can reach is that the sole reason he is calling me before this committee is to get me to say something - anything - that could vindicate his repeated public pledges that I end up, in his words, 'behind bars'," Fauci said.
Paul, the committee's Republican chairman, bypassed a full senate vote on the contempt resolution saying he did not "want to waste time" going through the procedure.
Paul, the committee's Republican chairman, bypassed a full Senate vote on the contempt resolution, saying he did not "want to waste time" following the usual procedure.
Normally, contempt resolutions then go to the full Senate, where they require a 60-vote majority. Republicans currently hold 53 seats in the 100-member Senate.
Fauci's attorney has argued that he believes that the former top health official is on "solid legal ground" going forward, adding that Paul "may be a doctor, but he is not a lawyer". Paul worked as an eye surgeon until he got elected to the US Senate in 2010.
"We are completely confident that Dr Fauci has a valid Fifth Amendment privilege here and is on solid legal ground in asserting it," attorney David Schertler said in an e-mail to CBS, the BBC's US partner, last week.
Taking the Fifth is not an admission of guilt - it is designed to protect individuals against coercion, mistakes, and unfair shifting of the burden to provide proof of wrongdoing.

title: All schools in England to get pupil attendance targets, government says
summary: The BBC understands schools will not be penalised for missing targets, but they will be monitored.
full_text:
All schools in England to get pupil attendance targets, government says
- Published
Every mainstream state school in England will be given their own target to improve pupil attendance, the government has confirmed.
Schools will also be encouraged to offer more clubs and activities on Fridays, to improve attendance at the end of the week.
It comes as official attendance data, published on Thursday, suggested school absence rates in England remained above pre-pandemic levels, with nearly one in five pupils missing at least 10% of school in the 2025/26 academic year.
Education minister Paul Waugh said the new attendance targets would take each school's local challenges into account, but that "every school has a role to play to improve attendance".
Before the Covid pandemic, when many schools closed to pupils for significant periods of time, attendance rates at English mainstream state schools regularly stayed above 95%, but schools have struggled to get back to those rates in the years since.
Thursday's figures, external suggested an overall attendance rate of 93% for 2025/26, a slight decrease on the previous year. That includes both authorised absences, such as illness, and unauthorised absences, which is when pupils miss school without permission or a valid reason.
The rates of persistent absence have doubled since the pandemic. A pupil is described as persistently absent if they miss at least 10% of school sessions.
In 2018/19, persistent absence rates for England state schools were around 10%, while the most recent data showed it was at 19% in 2025/26.
Pupils on free school meals and those with special educational needs and disabilities (SEND) were also still more likely to be absent from school than their peers.
Many mainstream schools in England were given attendance targets specific to their school in a widespread trial last year, but on Thursday the Department for Education (DfE) confirmed that every school would be getting their own target and that it would be monitored for the first time.
The BBC understands there will be no immediate penalties for schools who miss their attendance targets, but that the DfE will get in touch with schools that are off-track to make sure they are aware and taking action.
Schools could then be pointed towards best practice guidance, or encouraged to join with other schools in a local behaviour and attendance hub.
The regulator Ofsted already considers a schools' overall attendance rates in their inspections.
In an opinion piece published in The Independent newspaper on Thursday, newly-appointed education minister Paul Waugh said the latest attendance stats showed "progress has slowed over the past year", and that the government's response needed to be "broader, smarter and more ambitious".
Schools have been promised access to more data tools in the coming year to help them analyse individual pupils' attendance records, Waugh said, so they can identify concerns earlier and be "intervening more quickly when pupils begin to drift away from regular attendance".
Fridays are "becoming a particular weak spot for attendance", he added, and said he would be investigating why pupil illness absences are regularly significantly higher at the end of each week.
He called on schools to put on interesting clubs and enrichment sessions on Fridays "so every child stays engaged right through to the end of the week".
Paul Whiteman, general secretary of schools leaders' union NAHT, said Thursday's attendance data showed "just how hard it is to drive absence rates back down to pre-pandemic levels".
"Schools already go above and beyond in encouraging attendance, but it isn't a problem that they can solve alone or that government targets will fix," he said.
"The issue often has roots beyond the classroom, from illness and mental health challenges to poverty and unmet special educational needs."
He said it highlighted the importance of the government's upcoming reforms to the SEND system in England.
The data released on Thursday also showed that nearly 12% of pupils missed school in the week beginning Monday 22 June, when an exceptional heatwave was affecting parts of England, leading to the highest absence rate of the year.

title: Nadia Sawalha threatens ITV with legal action over Loose Women removal
summary: The TV panellist claims she has been treated unfairly due to her public support of Palestinian rights.
full_text:
Nadia Sawalha threatens ITV with legal action over Loose Women removal
- Published
Loose Women panellist Nadia Sawalha has threatened to take legal action against ITV, claiming the network dropped her for speaking out in support of Palestinian rights.
A legal organisation representing her has sent a pre-action letter to ITV, claiming the broadcaster "subjected Nadia to direct discrimination, indirect discrimination and harassment because of her protected philosophical beliefs".
In an Instagram video, external, Sawalha said she had become "the target of an escalating campaign of smears, complaints, hostile media coverage and targeted calls to have me removed from Loose Women".
She added: "Since then, ITV have taken me on and off Loose Women a number of times." BBC News has asked ITV for comment.
The presenter said she "began speaking publicly in support of Palestine in December 2023", two months after the 7 October Hamas attacks on Israel and Israel's subsequent military campaign in Gaza.
She said she was "speaking out against brutal oppression", but her critics have accused her of promoting false claims and conspiracies about Israel and Jewish people.
A group of Jewish executives in the entertainment industry recently sent a dossier to ITV, urging the channel not to reinstate her, citing what they called "repeated examples of conspiratorial rhetoric, inflammatory commentary, disinformation, and antisemitic discourse".
Sawalha said she hadn't had a chance to see the document and answer the accusations, but has denied antisemitism.
Two newspapers that previously accused Sawalha and her husband of antisemitism and supporting terrorism have since issued apologies and paid damages, external to the couple.
In her video on Thursday, Sawalha said she had "mostly been told" by ITV that "the reason for [my removal] was, and I quote, 'It's all a bit noisy out there for us'."
'Changing the goalposts'
The controversy, she alleges, prompted ITV to remove her on repeated occasions from the line-up of its long-running lunchtime programme.
"ITV have continued to take me on and off Loose Women, forever changing the goalposts whilst also saying they couldn't guarantee they wouldn't take me off again as it would depend on what was said," she said.
Sawalha added that she was "hired for being an opinionated woman on a discussion show and I've never brought up or spoken about Palestine directly on the show".
The presenter also said she wanted to express "how sad I am that it's got to this - believe me, I have appealed to ITV's hearts and minds, but to no avail".
The European Legal Support Center (ELSC), external, which supports pro-Palestinian cases, has written to ITV on her behalf, alleging she has been discriminated against because of her "anti-Zionist beliefs, which are protected under the Equality Act 2010".
Sawalha has appeared regularly on the daytime panel show, which sees four female media personalities discuss topical subjects, since 2013.
She also had an earlier stint on the panel between 1999 and 2002, shortly after playing Annie Palmer in EastEnders.
Her other TV credits include Casualty and The Bill, and she is also a former winner of Celebrity MasterChef.

title: NHS must plan for heatwaves like it does for winter, health secretary says
summary: The warning comes after the NHS sees a surge in patients and problems with equipment in high temperatures.
full_text:
NHS must plan for heatwaves like it does for winter, health secretary says
- Published
The NHS must prepare for the effects of heatwaves each year in the same way that it plans for cold weather in the winter, the health secretary has said.
Yvette Cooper said there had been a "big increase" in people attending A&Es because of the effect of hot weather this summer. Meanwhile, some hospitals have reported disruption due to key equipment failing in the heat.
In an interview with LBC Radio, Cooper called on people to look out for the elderly and other vulnerable people as well as urging better planning by the NHS.
It comes as Union released testimonies from ambulance workers describing the difficult and "vile" conditions they have had to work in.
The UK registered its 34th day of temperatures reaching 30C (86F) or higher in a calendar year on Tuesday, equalling the record set in 1995.
Forecasts suggest that this record is likely to be beaten as early as next week, with some suggesting the potential for a sixth heatwave to develop. Yellow heat warnings are already in place in some areas.
Every year the NHS sets out detailed plans for winter, including measures to cope with increases in patients.
- What does hot weather do to the body? 
  - Published22 June
- How do heat health alerts work? 
  - Published22 June
Speaking about the recent heatwaves, England's health secretary, who also gave an interview to the Guardian newspaper on the topic, said: "I spoke to A&E staff who were telling me that they've had a big increase in patients coming into A&E linked to the heat in a way that you would normally only see in the winter.
"So I've been clear: the NHS has to make sure we are preparing for summer pressures now in the same way we prepare for winter.
"What it means is making sure that you've got plans in place to respond to higher numbers of people coming in to A&E, for example, who are vulnerable because of the heat, and that you've got the arrangements in place to make sure people can then be returned from hospital as swiftly as possible.
"But it also needs much stronger prevention - we know that it's the elderly and vulnerable who are at risk when you have these heatwaves."
The call was echoed by Unison, which represents ambulance workers.
The union said emergency workers have been working in some very difficult conditions this summer.
Unison said its members had reported being sent out in ambulances in stifling heat with faulty or no air conditioning, and often with limited access to drinking water or toilet facilities.
It said this has occurred during shifts where staff have queued for hours outside hospitals to hand over patients in stifling temperatures.
One ambulance technician from Birmingham told the union working in the heat was "vile".
"We have one uniform whether it's minus 10 or 30 degrees. You're sweating even when you're just driving. We then go into hot care homes and houses.
"Doing CPR for 40 minutes in the heat is ten-times harder. Then you simply move on to the next job. I could have cried during my last shift. I often think, I can't do this again."
Unison ambulance national officer Sharan Bandesha said it was time for a re-think.
"Ambulance services have well-established plans for winter. It's increasingly clear they're needed for summer too.
As well as reports of a surge of patients being brought in for heat-related conditions, hospitals have reported problems with equipment, including scanners and IT systems, and difficult working conditions for staff, particularly at some of the older sites.
Alongside the risk of dehydration and heatstroke, a bout of extreme heat raises the chances of complications from chronic conditions like advanced heart, kidney and respiratory failure.
In a preliminary assessment last month, the UK Health Security Agency said there were an estimated 2,877 heat-related deaths during the May and June heatwaves, almost double the figure for the whole of last year.
And it said that it was "likely that 2026 could see the highest number of heat-associated deaths on record", surpassing the number in 2022 when the agency started studying them.

title: Barcelona? Real Madrid? Man City's Rodri has a decision to make
summary: Midfielder Rodri may have a huge decision to make this summer on whether to join Real Madrid or Barcelona, should he decide to leave Manchester City.
full_text:
Barcelona? Real Madrid? Man City's Rodri has a decision to make
- Published
Manchester City midfielder Rodri may have a huge decision to make this summer on whether to join La Liga giants Real Madrid or Barcelona - should he decide to leave Etihad Stadium.
The 30-year-old is into the final year of his deal at City and is yet to sign fresh terms.
Real have held a long-term interest in signing the player, but two separate sources told BBC Sport on Thursday that Spanish champions Barcelona have joined the race for his signature.
To add to the intrigue, Barca sources have distanced themselves from such talk when approached to comment by BBC Sport.
- How do Manchester City manage the Rodri dilemma? 
  - Published25 July
A big decision to make
Rodri missed much of the 2024-25 campaign after sustaining a serious knee injury, and parts of last season were disrupted by a hamstring issue.
However, the 2024 Ballon d'Or winner was back to his best at the World Cup in the summer, leading Spain to their second title and being named player of the tournament.
Rodri said earlier this season his future would be sorted out after the tournament, but he is currently out of action after undergoing back surgery.
City are currently on a pre-season tour in the Far East and face Arsenal in the Community Shield next Sunday, but Rodri is yet to link up with his team-mates. Once he does return, he has a major decision to make.
Does he sign the deal that is on offer from City, see out the final months of his contract and become a free agent next summer or take up the tantalising prospect of a return to his homeland?
City sources have previously told BBC Sport they are "counting on" the player for next season, while a significant fee would need to be offered to even consider a sale of the player.
A move to Barca would allow Rodri to join the title winners for the past two seasons and unite with national team compatriots Ferran Torres, Lamine Yamal, Pau Cubarsi and Pedri.
However, he may enjoy a quick reunion with ex-City team-mate Bernardo Silva, who joined Real on a free this summer, and the club will be led by the returning Jose Mourinho.
Rodri, though, may not receive a universal reception if he joins one of the two Spanish giants.
He played for Atletico Madrid in the past and having previously said "you can't turn down the best clubs in the world" with regards to Real, the reception at Nou Camp would be highly interesting if he did end up there.
Who could replace Rodri?
Rodri has won four Premier League titles, the Champions League and two FA Cups since joining City in 2019 and has established himself as being not only integral to the side, but as one of the best midfielders in the world.
Having already lost Silva this summer, losing Rodri would be a significant blow and would require one of Mateo Kovacic, Nico Gonzalez or Tijjani Reijnders to step up, with all three featuring in pre-season so far.
Club record signing Elliot Anderson is set to be a starter, so there would be a big hole to fill alongside the England international.
City remain in talks to sign 18-year-old midfielder Ayyoub Bouaddi from Lille, but it would be a big ask for the Moroccan teenager to fill such esteemed boots.
